auth.setup.pin_rule.description: One-line rule under the admin PIN heading of the first-run wizard (step 6), read before typing: the PIN is 4 to 8 digits, numbers only. Written with words ('4 to 8') because screen readers speak it; the error text uses the en dash form.

elevation.summary.cloud_sync_now.description: Manager PIN prompt summary: what approving does — the till asks the cloud for changes right away.

setup.finish_busy.description: Label of the first-run wizard's final button (normally 'Start selling') while the setup request is running; the button ignores further presses until the page changes.

setup.busy_hint.description: Status line shown under the first-run wizard's final button while setup is saving; tells the owner not to close the window (registration can take up to about ten seconds).

journal.col.order_no.description: Column heading in the sales journal list: the short order number the customer waits for (digits only), shown beside the receipt number, which stays the sale's identity.

journal.filter.search.description: Label of the journal's search field: type a receipt number, or the short order number a customer holds, to find the sale.

receipt.order_no_label.description: Small label above the large order number on the on-screen receipt and, on the thermal receipt, on its own line above the double-size number (80 mm paper: 42 columns). The number itself is printed separately; do not include it.
receipt.order_no_label.review_exception: A plain operational label for the short order number (not a legal receipt line: the legal receipt number is the separate receipt.paper.receipt_no); ut-docs#6663 UX review.

reports.eod.late_other_till.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late section, on screen and on the printed Z report: name shown for a till that is no longer in this till's list of tills, followed by a short id so two such tills stay apart.
placeholders: short id of the till (first 8 characters)

reports.eod.late_earliest_col.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late table: column header, the date and time the oldest late row from that till was made.

reports.eod.late_no_sale.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late table: column header, the number of late no-sale drawer opens (no money moved).

reports.eod.late_cleared.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late table: column header, the amount (or on older reports the number) of baskets cleared before payment, received late.

reports.eod.late_entries.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late table: column header, the number of late rows from that till (all kinds together).

reports.eod.late_till.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late table: column header, the till the rows came from.

reports.eod.late_earliest.description: Reports, End of day, recorded-late detail: line under the explanation on older reports that store one overall time.
placeholders: date and time the oldest late row was made

reports.eod.late_note.description: Reports, End of day, archived report detail: explanation under the recorded-late heading. Must make clear the figures are inside the totals, not extra.

reports.eod.late_title.description: Reports, End of day, archived report detail: heading of the table of rows made on another till before the previous close and received after it. They are already included in this report's totals.

reports.zpaper.late_no_sale.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: indented row label before the number of late no-sale drawer opens from one till (no money moved).

reports.zpaper.late_cleared.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: indented row label with the count of baskets cleared before payment on one till and received late; their amount follows (not on reports printed before this was recorded).
placeholders: number of late cleared baskets from this till

reports.zpaper.late_refunds.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: indented row label with the count of late refunds from one till; the refunded amount is printed after it with a minus sign.
placeholders: number of late refunds from this till

reports.zpaper.late_sales.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: indented row label with the count of late sales from one till; their amount is printed after it.
placeholders: number of late sales from this till

reports.zpaper.late_entries.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: indented row label before the number of late rows from one till (sales, refunds, cleared baskets and drawer opens together).

reports.zpaper.late_earliest.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: row label before the date and time the oldest late row was made (per till, or overall on older reports). The date is printed after it on the same line.

reports.zpaper.late_included.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: second explanation line. The amounts listed are already inside the report's totals, not added on top. Wraps onto a second printed line if longer than 42 characters. Must never read as an extra amount.

reports.zpaper.late_made_before.description: Printed Z report, recorded-late section: first explanation line under the heading. These rows were made on another till before the previous day-end close. Wraps onto a second printed line if longer than 42 characters.

reports.zpaper.late_title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section listing rows made on another till before the previous close and received by this till after it. They are already counted in this report's totals. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them. Wraps onto a second printed line if longer than 42 characters.

import.problem_grid.name_invalid_charact.description: Row note when Import anyway was ticked but the typed corrected name holds a tab or invisible character; the row stays skipped. Sits in a narrow table cell / phone card.

import.status.category_invalid_character.description: Import preview/result row reason: the row's category name holds a line break, tab or invisible formatting character, so the row is not imported and no category or item is created. Sits in a narrow table cell / phone card.

import.status.department_invalid_charact.description: Import preview/result row reason: the row's department (top-level category) name holds a line break, tab or invisible formatting character, so the row is not imported and no department or item is created. Sits in a narrow table cell / phone card.

import.status.name_invalid_characters.description: Import preview/result row reason: the item name in the uploaded file holds a line break, tab or invisible formatting character, so the row is not imported. Sits in a narrow table cell / phone card.

basket.tile_in_basket.description: Phone sale screen: screen-reader text added to an item tile's name when that item is in the current sale, e.g. "Latte, 2 in basket". Not shown visually (the tile shows only a number badge). The string starts with a comma and a space as a separator, because it is read right after the price ("Latte £2.50, 2 in basket"); keep a leading separator in translations. Write the number as %d exactly (the till replaces only a literal %d); the string has one form for every count.
placeholders: how many of this item are in the current sale

receipt.vouchers.balance_on_label.description: Left part of the balance row on a gift-voucher slip printed again from the voucher's page, shown when the voucher's current balance differs from its original value; the amount is printed right-aligned on the same row by the printer layout, so do not include it. The placeholder is the date the balance was read (the day the slip is printed, about 10 characters) and may be reordered (%[1]s). Printed on 58/80 mm paper: the whole row is 42 columns wide, so keep the label short.
placeholders: date the balance was read (the day the slip is printed)

designer.error.shared_code.description: Alert shown when a reorder from the Designer or the sale screen is refused because two buttons use the same SKU or barcode at or before the last position moved: names the code, the order was not changed, and the fix is to give the items distinct SKUs or barcodes.
placeholders: the shared SKU or barcode

designer.receipt.voucher_slip_text.description: Label of the receipt designer's multi-line field for the shop's own text printed at the bottom of gift voucher slips (not on receipts).

designer.receipt.voucher_slip_text_hint.description: Help line under the receipt designer's gift voucher slip text field: where it prints (every gift voucher slip, never receipts), examples of what shops write, and the limits.
placeholders: maximum number of lines
maximum number of characters

designer.receipt.voucher_slip_text_too_l.description: Shown next to the Save button when the gift voucher slip text is over its line or character limit; nothing on the form was saved, so it says so and what to do.
placeholders: maximum number of lines
maximum number of characters

plugins.install.error.code_refused_appst.description: Message shown when a plugin install, import or update is refused because the App Store build of the app cannot download or import code (Apple guideline 2.5.2). Names the built-in card payment plugins as the alternative.

plugin.secret.get_from_my.description: Heading of the row on a plugin's settings page that fetches the plugin's key from my.universaltill.com with a one-time code instead of typing it. 'my.' is the owner's web page for their shop.

plugin.secret.scan.description: Button: open the camera to scan the one-time code shown on my.universaltill.com.

plugin.secret.type.description: Button: type the one-time code shown on my.universaltill.com by hand.

plugin.secret.scan_hint.description: Instruction over the camera view while scanning the one-time code.

plugin.secret.no_camera.description: Shown when the camera cannot be used (no camera, permission denied, busy); the typed code field opens instead.

plugin.secret.code_label.description: Label of the field where the 26-character one-time code from my.universaltill.com is typed.

plugin.secret.send_code.description: Button that sends the typed one-time code to the cloud.

plugin.secret.cancel.description: Button that closes the camera view without scanning.

plugin.secret.offline.description: Shown when the one-time code could not be sent because the till has no internet. The code is not kept.

plugin.secret.accepted.description: Shown right after the cloud accepted the one-time code.

plugin.secret.waiting.description: Status while the till waits for the key to arrive from the cloud after the code was accepted.

plugin.secret.applied.description: Status when the key arrived from my.universaltill.com and was saved on this till. The key itself is never shown.

plugin.secret.key_set.description: Shown in place of a key's value on the settings page once a key is stored. Never the key itself.

plugin.secret.bad_code.description: One message for every refused one-time code (wrong, expired, already used, other shop). It must not say which.

plugin.secret.rate_limited.description: Shown when the cloud refuses more one-time code attempts for now.

plugin.secret.satellite.description: Replaces the code buttons on a satellite till: only the main till receives the key.

plugins.manage.built_in_hint.description: Note under the Built in heading on the Plugins page: these plugins ship inside the app, update only with an app update and are switched on or off.

plugins.manage.error.bundled_main_till_c.description: Inline message on the Plugins page of a satellite till when someone tries to switch a built-in plugin on or off: the main till decides.

plugins.manage.error.bundled_no_uninstal.description: Inline message on the Plugins page when someone tries to uninstall a plugin that ships inside the app.

plugins.manage.error.bundled_trust_fixed.description: Error answer when someone tries to change the trust level of a plugin that ships inside the app.

plugins.manage.main_till_controls.description: Small tag on a built-in plugin card on a satellite till: its on/off state is set on the main till.

plugins.manage.group.built_in.description: Heading above the plugins that ship inside the app (Stripe and SumUp card payments on the App Store build) on the Plugins page.

receipt.vouchers.issued_on.description: Printed on a gift voucher slip under the code: the date the voucher was sold. Printed on 58/80 mm paper.
placeholders: date the voucher was issued

receipt.vouchers.topped_up_on.description: Printed on a gift voucher top-up slip under the code: the date this amount was added to the voucher. Printed on 58/80 mm paper.
placeholders: date of this top-up

receipt.vouchers.reprinted.description: Printed on a gift-voucher slip printed again from the voucher's page, so it can be told from the slip handed over at the sale. Printed on 58/80 mm paper.
placeholders: date the slip was reprinted

settings.cloud_staff.enable.description: Checkbox label that turns on sending per-staff sales figures to cloud reports for the whole shop.

settings.cloud_staff.help.description: Help text of the manager-only Settings card for per-staff sales in cloud reports: staff are identified by staff ID, never by name, and it is off by default.

settings.cloud_staff.title.description: Title of the manager-only Settings card that controls whether per-staff sales figures are sent to the shop's cloud reports.

settings.cloud_staff.window_note.description: Note above the Save button: changing the switch re-sends or clears per-staff figures for the last 14 days, while figures already sent for older days stay in the cloud reports.

settings.cloud_staff.works_council.description: Factual note under the checkbox: per-staff figures can show how individual staff work, and in Germany a works council may need to agree first. Keep the conditional wording ("may need to agree"); never turn it into "must" or claim the shop is compliant.

status.cloud_sync.at.description: Status-bar chip: when this till last heard from the cloud, an hour or more ago. Short, one line.
placeholders: a clock time for today (14:05), or a date and time for an older sync, already formatted

status.cloud_sync.hint.description: Tooltip of the status-bar cloud sync chip. 'my.' is the cloud portal's product name; keep it as is.

status.cloud_sync.just_now.description: Status-bar chip: this till heard from the cloud less than a minute ago. Short, one line.

status.cloud_sync.minutes_ago_plural.description: Status-bar chip: minutes since this till last heard from the cloud, 1 to 59 ({count} is the number of minutes; plural forms per language). Short, one line; an abbreviation for minutes is fine.

status.cloud_sync.never.description: Status-bar chip: this registered till has not yet heard from the cloud. Short, one line.

status.cloud_sync.stale_hint.description: Tooltip of the status-bar cloud sync chip when the last sync is 10 minutes old or more.

status.cloud_sync.still_trying.description: Line in the status-bar cloud sync chip after Sync now when the cloud did not answer within a few seconds (offline or slow). The till keeps retrying; selling is not affected.

status.cloud_sync.sync_now.description: Button in the status-bar cloud sync chip (managers): ask the cloud for this till's latest changes now. A verb; short.

status.cloud_sync.syncing.description: Label of the Sync now button while the till waits (up to a few seconds) for the cloud's answer.

vouchers.print_slip.button.description: Button on a gift voucher's page (manager): prints that voucher's gift slip again on this till's receipt printer, without a receipt.

receipt.printer.nothing_printed.description: Inline notice on a kiosk till whose screen can't open a print dialog, shown when a Print button didn't print. True whether no printer is set up or the set-up printer is off or unplugged. Don't say "no printer", and don't say the document was saved or sent. A link "Set up a receipt printer", or "Ask a manager...", follows.
receipt.printer.nothing_printed.review_exception: Operational UI chrome pointing staff at Settings; no legal, fiscal or customer-facing receipt wording.

receipt.printer.set_up.description: Link label to Settings > Receipt printer: on the receipt warning, the print notice and the gift voucher page of a kiosk till that can't open a print dialog. Verb phrase on a button-sized link; keep it short.
receipt.printer.set_up.review_exception: Operational UI chrome pointing staff at Settings; no legal, fiscal or customer-facing receipt wording.

receipt.printer.ask_manager.description: Shown instead of the link "Set up a receipt printer" when the signed-in staff member can't open Settings (for example a cashier). Full sentence.
receipt.printer.ask_manager.review_exception: Operational UI chrome pointing staff at Settings; no legal, fiscal or customer-facing receipt wording.

vouchers.print_slip.printing.description: Shown next to Print voucher slip while the slip is being sent to the receipt printer.

vouchers.print_slip.done.description: Inline confirmation after Print voucher slip on a gift voucher's page succeeded.

vouchers.print_slip.not_printable.description: Inline message when Print voucher slip is pressed for a voucher that was voided or used up since the page loaded.

vouchers.print_slip.balance_unknown_note.description: Shown above Print voucher slip on an additional till when the main till could not be reached: the slip then prints only the original value, without the current balance. Says why and tells the owner to check the balance on the main till before handing the slip over.

shifts.close_no_sale_opens.description: Shifts page, shift-close confirmation: a second line shown under the expected/actual/variance message only when the cash drawer was opened without a sale during the closed shift. Informational; it never changes the cash figures.
placeholders: number of times the drawer was opened without a sale during the shift

shifts.open_confirmed.description: Shifts page: confirmation shown in the open-shift form's result area after a shift is opened successfully. Plain sentence, no identifiers.

reports.eod.fiscal_device.mismatch_count.description: Reports > End of day archive, Turkish fiscal device (ÖKC) check: shown when the device's receipt count differs from the till's tender count on it.
placeholders: the device's receipt count (a number)
the till's tender count on the device (a number)

reports.eod.no_sale_opens.description: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: column header, the number of drawer opens per cashier. Also used on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_title.description: Reports, End of day, archived report detail: heading of the table of cash-drawer opens without a sale. Also used as the row label (with the count) on the Shifts page's Current Shift card.

reports.eod.no_sale_total.description: Reports, End of day, no-sale table: label of the total row.

reports.eod.x_report_link.description: Reports, End of day tab: a link under the heading to the X report on the Shifts page.

reports.eod.day_x.title.description: Reports, End of day tab: heading of the day-so-far section. A read of everything since the last day close, NOT an end-of-day (Z) report.

reports.eod.day_x.intro.description: Reports, End of day tab: one paragraph under the heading saying the day-so-far report uses the end-of-day layout but closes, stores and resets nothing.

reports.eod.day_x.show.description: Reports, End of day tab: button that loads the day-so-far figures. Pressing it again reads fresh figures.

reports.eod.day_x.hide.description: Reports, End of day tab: button that hides the loaded day-so-far figures.

reports.eod.day_x.as_of.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: label before the time the figures were read.

reports.eod.day_x.since.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line naming the last day close the figures start from.
placeholders: date and time of the last day close

reports.eod.day_x.since_first.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line shown instead of the date when this till has never closed a day.

reports.eod.day_x.empty.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: line shown when nothing was sold since the last day close.

reports.eod.day_x.paper_label.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: accessible name of the preview block that shows the printed report as text.

reports.eod.day_x.print.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: button that prints the report (figures as of the moment it is pressed) on the receipt printer. Not an end-of-day (Z) report.

reports.eod.day_x.printing.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: short status beside the Print button while the print request runs (up to 15 seconds).

reports.eod.day_x.print_ok.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: confirmation beside the Print button once the receipt printer accepted the report.

reports.eod.day_x.print_failed.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the receipt printer is off, not set up or did not answer. Names the Receipt printer settings section and the Print day so far button, so keep those names identical to their translations.

reports.eod.day_x.failed.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the figures could not be loaded. Names the Show day so far button, so keep that name identical to its translation.

reports.eod.day_x.invalid_request.description: Reports, End of day tab, day so far: error when the request could not be read (malformed or oversized form).

reports.eod.day_x.paper.title.description: Printed day-so-far report on the receipt printer: title line at the top, above the end-of-day layout. A read of the day so far, never an end-of-day (Z) report. Printed in capitals where the language has them; plain ASCII hyphen so it prints on every charset.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting cash-drawer opens with no sale (no money moved, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.no_sale_total.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: row label before the total number of no-sale drawer opens. A longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

plugins.install.error.revoked.description: Install-status message when installing or updating a plugin version the marketplace has withdrawn (revoked). Shown on the Plugins page.

plugins.manage.error.revoked.description: Inline message on the Plugins page when turning on, or rolling back to, a plugin version the marketplace has withdrawn (revoked).

settings.display.awake_hours.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle hours.
placeholders: number of hours

settings.display.awake.description: Label of the Android-only Settings > Display dropdown that sets how long the till keeps the tablet screen on without a touch.

settings.display.awake_help.description: Help line under the Android-only keep-screen-on dropdown.

settings.display.awake_minutes.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle minutes.
placeholders: number of minutes

settings.display.awake_never.description: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen never sleeps while the till app is open.

shifts.adjustment_confirmed.description: Shifts page: confirmation shown in the cash adjustment / payout form's result area after an adjustment or payout is recorded (also returned to the Pfand return dialog). Plain sentence, no identifiers.

shifts.x_report.print.description: Shifts page, loaded X report: button that prints the X report (figures as of the moment it is pressed) on the receipt printer. Not an end-of-day (Z) report.

shifts.x_report.print_ok.description: Shifts page, X report: confirmation beside the Print button once the receipt printer accepted the X report.

shifts.x_report.printing.description: Shifts page, X report: short status beside the Print button while the print request runs (up to 15 seconds).

shifts.x_report.print_failed.description: Shifts page, X report: error beside the Print button when the receipt printer is off, not set up or did not answer. Names the Receipt printer settings section and the Print X report button, so keep those two names identical to their translations.

shifts.x_report.paper.title.description: Printed X report on the receipt printer: title line at the top. A mid-shift read, never an end-of-day (Z) report. Printed in capitals where the language has them.

shifts.x_report.paper.not_a_close.description: Printed X report on the receipt printer: line under the title saying the report only reads the figures and closes or resets nothing. Used by the shift X report and by the day-so-far X report. One 42-character line.

shifts.x_report.title.description: Shifts page, Current Shift card: heading of the mid-shift report section. A read of the open shift so far, NOT an end-of-day (Z) report.

shifts.x_report.not_a_close.description: Shifts page, X report section: one line under the heading saying the report only reads figures and closes nothing.

shifts.x_report.show.description: Shifts page, X report section: button that loads the report figures. Pressing it again reads fresh figures.

shifts.x_report.hide.description: Shifts page, X report section: button in the loaded report that removes the figures from the screen again.

shifts.x_report.generated_at.description: Shifts page, X report: label before the time the figures were read. A point-in-time read, not a period.

shifts.x_report.count.description: Shifts page, X report: column header for the number of sales, returns and similar.

shifts.x_report.sales.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the completed sales of this shift (count and gross amount).

shifts.x_report.returns.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the returns of this shift (count and amount refunded).

shifts.x_report.tax.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the tax on sales minus the tax on returns.

shifts.x_report.voids.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for sales voided during this shift (count and amount).

shifts.x_report.cleared.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for baskets the cashier cleared before taking payment (count and value). Not revenue, and not the No sale drawer count shown further down.

shifts.x_report.section_tenders.description: Shifts page, X report: sub-heading of the table of payments per payment method.

shifts.x_report.method.description: Shifts page, X report: column header of the payment method name.

shifts.x_report.received.description: Shifts page, X report: column header for the amount received by a payment method.

shifts.x_report.refunded.description: Shifts page, X report: column header for the amount refunded through a payment method.

shifts.x_report.no_payments.description: Shifts page, X report: shown instead of the payments table when the shift has no payments.

shifts.x_report.section_cash.description: Shifts page, X report: sub-heading of the cash breakdown (opening cash, cash sales, adjustments, expected). Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

shifts.x_report.cash_sales.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for cash taken from sales after cash refunds and change given. Cash tips are shown on their own line.

shifts.x_report.adjustments_total.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the total of the shift's cash adjustments and payouts. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

shifts.x_report.first_receipt.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the first receipt number of the shift.

shifts.x_report.last_receipt.description: Shifts page, X report: row label for the last receipt number of the shift.

shifts.x_report.no_open_shift.description: Shifts page, X report: error shown (and returned to API clients) when the chosen register has no open shift, usually because it was closed meanwhile.

shifts.x_report.invalid_register.description: Shifts page, X report: error for a register value that is malformed or too long.

shifts.x_report.invalid_request.description: Shifts page, X report: error when the request could not be read.

shifts.x_report.failed.description: Shifts page, X report: error when the figures could not be read; says what to do next.

agent.action.settings_set.description: Title of the core-rendered confirm card when the AI assistant asks to change one or more shop settings. Nothing changes until the operator presses Confirm.

agent.field.setting.description: Column value on the assistant's confirm card for a settings change: names the row's change as a setting (the row's item is the setting's own label from the Settings screen).

agent.value.on.description: Before/after value on the assistant's confirm card for an on/off setting that is switched on.

agent.value.off.description: Before/after value on the assistant's confirm card for an on/off setting that is switched off.

settings.update.android.authorized.description: Short confirmation returned when a manager approves installing the Android update; the download starts next.

settings.update.android.busy.description: Android till: a manager tapped install while a sale, self-order or table order (possibly on another screen of this till) or a shift close is open; installing restarts the app and would lose it.

settings.update.android.downloaded.description: Android till, status-bar chip and Settings → Software update: the update was downloaded overnight and checked; one tap opens Android's installer. Replaces the whole chip label, so keep 'Update'.
placeholders: version number of the downloaded update, without a leading v

settings.update.android.install_now.description: Settings → Software update button label on an Android till once the update is already downloaded.

settings.update.managed_by_app_store.description: Settings → Software update on the App Store (iOS) build: one status line saying Apple's App Store updates the app, so the till has no update check or install button. Keep the store's official name.

settings.update.managed_by_store.description: Settings → Software update on the Google Play build: one status line saying Google Play updates the app, so the till has no update check or install button. Keep the store's official name.

settings.update.error.busy.description: Shown when Update now is pressed while another update is still being installed on this till.

settings.update.error.failed.description: Generic message when installing an update failed for any reason without a more specific message; the details go to the till's log.

settings.update.error.newer_data.description: Shown when an in-app update is refused because the till runs a test (pre-release/nightly/hand-built) build and the release may be older than its database. Must never suggest deleting or resetting data.

settings.update.held_back.description: Result of 'Check for updates' when a release exists but is not offered because this till runs a test (pre-release) build whose data may be newer than the release. Must never suggest deleting or resetting data.

recovery.app_older_than_data.description: Recovery screen explanation when the till's database was written by a newer app version than the one now running (for example after installing an older or test build). Tells the owner to install the latest version. Must never suggest deleting or resetting data.

settings.update.error.verify_failed.description: Shown when the downloaded update failed verification (its checksum did not match, or the release's signed checksum list did not verify), so nothing was installed.

promotions.customer.clear.description: Aria-label and tooltip of the x button beside the promotion's customer field; after Save any customer can use the code.

promotions.customer.deleted.description: Promotions list and dialog: the promotion is bound to a customer who no longer exists on this till (erased elsewhere). Shown instead of an id.

promotions.customer.unpicked.description: Promotion dialog error when text was typed in the customer field but no search result was chosen.

promotions.error.customer_unknown.description: Save refused in the promotion dialog: the chosen customer is not on this till (deleted or never existed).

sync.error.name_too_long.description: Error body (400) the main till returns to a joining till, at pairing or enrolment, when the till name it sent is longer than 60 characters. The till is not enrolled and the one-time code is not used up.

sync.link.rejoin.description: Status-bar chip on a joined till whose connection to the main till was dropped (its data was restored onto a new device): tells the owner to join the main till again. Links to the Tills page.

sync.link.rejoin_hint.description: Tooltip of the 'join the main till again' status-bar chip: explains that the till no longer uses its old connection, that it keeps selling, and where to join again.

tills.rejoin_needed_help.description: Notice on a joined till's Tills page after its data was restored onto a new device: the steps to join the main till again, and a warning not to revoke the original till if it is still in use. 'Join an existing shop' is the label of that section on the same page.

app.name.description: The product name, shown in the window title, the header and the about page. A brand name: never translate it.

subscription.cap.order_tracking.description: Name of the paid capability customer order tracking (tracking QR on the kiosk confirmation and receipt), listed on the Subscription card and in the paused-feature banner when the shop's plan no longer includes it.

subscription.plan.local_plus.description: Name of the Local Plus subscription plan (the cheapest paid tier), shown as the shop's plan on the Subscription card and status chip. A product name: never translate it.

tills.main_unreachable_help_offline.description: Notice on a joined till's Tills page while the main till is not answering: the till keeps selling, reconnects by itself, what to check.

tills.join.rejoin_sales_warning.description: Warning above the join tabs on a till that is already joined to a main till and has sales: joining another main till replaces its data, but its unsent sales are sent there first.

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refus.description: Join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active).
placeholders: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.join_error.unsent_not_sent.description: Join error on a joined till re-joining a (new) main till: its sales that never reached a main till could not be sent there first, so the join was refused and nothing on this till changed.
placeholders: how many unsent sales this till has

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes.description: Join error on a joined till: its day closes (Z reports) that the cloud must keep are not uploaded yet; joining would wipe them, so the join waits.
placeholders: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

tills.main_unreachable_replaced.description: Line in the 'main till isn't answering' notice on a joined till's Tills page: what to do when the main till was replaced, and that unsent sales go to the new main till first.

tills.join.rejoin_note.description: Note in a joined till's 'join an existing shop' section: joining another main till sends its unsent sales there first.
placeholders: how many unsent sales this till has

common.back.description: Button that returns to the previous screen or step.

common.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog or form without saving anything.

common.confirm.description: Button in a confirmation dialog that carries out the action the dialog asks about (delete, revoke, deactivate). Cancel is beside it.

common.clear.description: Button that empties a field, search or selection.

common.close.description: Button that closes a panel or dialog.

common.discard_confirm.description: Confirmation question shown when the user leaves a form that has unsaved changes.

plugins.trust.confirm_ok.description: Confirm button on the unverified-publisher trust question: trusts the publisher and continues the download or install.

plugins.trust.revoked.description: Tag on an installed plugin's card on the Plugins page: a manager marked this plugin as not trusted on this till.

plugins.trust.revoked_hint.description: Tooltip on the Not trusted tag of an installed plugin's card: explains the plugin was marked as not trusted on this till.

issuereport.discard_keep.description: Dismiss button on the discard-report question: keeps the bug report being written.

common.discard.description: Confirm button on the discard-unsaved-changes question: throws away the edits.

common.keep_editing.description: Dismiss button on the discard-unsaved-changes question: returns to the unsaved form.

common.done.description: Button that finishes a step or closes an editing mode after the work is saved.

common.edit.description: Button or link that opens a record for editing.

common.error.invalid_upload.description: Error shown when an uploaded file can't be read or is the wrong type.

common.error.manager_or_admin_required.description: Error shown when a cashier tries an action only a manager or an admin may do.

common.error.name_invalid_characters.description: Error shown when a name typed on an admin screen (item, variant, category, modifier, option set, tax code, register) or this till's own name (Settings, setup, pairing) contains a line break, tab or invisible formatting character. The name is not saved.

common.error.network.description: Error shown when a request fails because the till can't reach the server or another till.

common.error.outcome_unknown.description: Error shown when the connection drops after the operator confirmed an action (manager PIN or confirm prompt) but before the till answered, so nobody knows if the action ran. Tells them to check before repeating it; there is no retry button.

common.error.outcome_timeout.description: Error shown when the till itself did not answer an action within 30 seconds (it was slow, the connection was fine), so nobody knows if the action ran. Tells them to check before repeating it; there is no retry button. Sibling of common.error.outcome_unknown, which is for a dropped connection.

common.error.server.description: Generic error shown when an action fails for an unexpected reason.

common.loading.description: Short status text shown while a list or panel is loading.

common.money.invalid.description: Validation message under an amount field when the input is not a valid amount. Keep both example amounts and both separators (dot and comma).

common.money.invalid_whole.description: Validation message under an amount field that accepts whole numbers only.

common.no_results.description: Empty-state text when a search finds nothing.

common.percent.invalid.description: Validation message under a percentage field. Keep both examples and both separators (dot and comma).

common.show_less.description: Toggle that collapses an expanded list or text.

common.show_more.description: Toggle that expands a shortened list or text.

common.view.description: Button or link that opens a record read-only.

import.file_plugin.detected.description: Shown above an import preview when an installed importer plugin recognised the uploaded export file and read it instead of the standard importer.
placeholders: the importer plugin's name

import.file_plugin.too_large.description: Error when an uploaded file is over the 32 MB an importer plugin may read; tells the user to split it.

import.file_plugin.upload_again.description: Hint under a failed import of a file an importer plugin read: the file must be chosen and previewed again.

import.file_plugin.use_standard.description: Button under an importer plugin's preview that reads the same file with the till's own standard importer instead.

import.issue.apply_failed.description: Import preview/result row detail: the row passed checks but could not be saved. Sits in a narrow table cell.

import.issue.barcode_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the same barcode is on two or more rows of this import.
placeholders: the barcode that appears on more than one row

import.issue.barcode_invalid.description: Import row detail: a barcode on the row contains characters a barcode may not have (only letters, digits and hyphens are allowed).

import.issue.barcode_not_accepted.description: Import row detail: the till's barcode settings (enabled barcode types) reject this barcode.
placeholders: the barcode the till refused

import.issue.barcode_taken.description: Import row detail: the barcode is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.
placeholders: the barcode that already belongs to another item

import.issue.category_level_invalid.description: Import row detail: one level of the row's category path is empty, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.category_too_deep.description: Import row detail: the category path has more nested levels than the till supports.
placeholders: the maximum number of category levels allowed (a number)

import.issue.description_invalid.description: Import row detail: the product description sent for this row is longer than 1000 characters or has hidden control or direction-changing characters. Line breaks are fine.

import.issue.external_id_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the other system's record ID appears on two or more rows of this import. 'ID' is the product's ID in the previous system.

import.issue.external_id_invalid.description: Import row detail: the row has no ID from the other system, or it is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.item_already_matched.description: Import row detail: an earlier row of this same import already matched the catalog item this row would update.

import.issue.item_linked_elsewhere.description: Import row detail: the catalog item that matches this row by barcode or SKU was already imported from a different record of the other system.
placeholders: the other system's record ID the item is already linked to

import.issue.name_invalid.description: Import row detail: the product name is missing, too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.net_quantity_invalid.description: Import row detail: the pre-packed product's net quantity (its content: grams, millilitres or a count) is incomplete or not valid. 'g', 'ml' and 'ea' are unit codes: keep them as they are.

import.issue.price_invalid.description: Import row detail: the price is missing, negative or implausibly large.

import.issue.reorder_level_invalid.description: Import row warning: the item was imported, but its reorder level (the low-stock threshold) from the file was not used because it could not be read as a whole number in the allowed range; tells the user to write it without thousands separators.
placeholders: the value from the file exactly as written, e.g. '2.5'
the lowest allowed reorder level, in the locale's digits, e.g. '0'
the highest allowed reorder level, in the locale's digits and deliberately without thousands separators, e.g. '1000000'

import.issue.row_not_object.description: Import row detail: the importer sent something for this row that is not a product record.

import.issue.row_not_single_object.description: Import row detail: the importer sent more than one product record in one row.

import.issue.sku_duplicate.description: Import row detail: the same SKU (stock-keeping code) is on two or more rows of this import.

import.issue.sku_invalid.description: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is too long or has forbidden characters.

import.issue.sku_taken.description: Import row detail: the SKU (stock-keeping code) is already used by a different item in the catalog, so the row is not applied.

import.issue.stock_out_of_range.description: Import row detail: the stock quantity is not a usable number or is implausibly large.

import.issue.too_many_barcodes.description: Import row detail: the row lists more barcodes for one product than the till allows.
placeholders: the maximum number of barcodes allowed on one item (a number)

import.issue.vat_out_of_range.description: Import row detail: the tax rate is below 0 or above 100 percent.

import.status.sku_reused_renumbered.description: Warning on an import row (Preview and result) whose item number from the old till's backup is also used by an earlier item in the same file, so this item gets a new number instead of being dropped. Sits in a narrow table cell after other status text: keep it short and lower case.
placeholders: the item number from the backup file that several items share, e.g. '30006'
the new item number this item gets instead, e.g. '30006-2'

import.system.ask_manager.description: Shown on the import page's 'From another till system' section to a user who may not install plugins or edit their settings: who to ask instead. Also shown when no importer is installed.

import.system.busy.description: Busy message while the till fetches products from the shop's previous till system through an importer plugin (can take minutes).

import.system.change.active.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product is active (sellable). One word, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.age_restricted.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: whether the product needs a staff ID (age) check before it is sold. Short, lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.barcode.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's barcode. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.category.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's category. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.description.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's description text. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.name.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's name. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.net_quantity.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: a pre-packed product's net quantity (its content, e.g. 250 g). Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.price.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's selling price. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.stock.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's stock count. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.change.vat.description: Name of a changed field in an import preview row: the product's VAT rate. Lower case, joined into a list.

import.system.changes.description: Import preview row detail listing which fields of an existing product the import would change. Sits in a narrow table cell: keep it short and lower case.
placeholders: comma-separated list of changed field names, e.g. 'price, stock'

import.system.col.detail.description: Column heading in the import preview table: what changes or what is wrong with the row.

import.system.col.name.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the product name.

import.system.col.result.description: Column heading in the import preview table: whether the row is new, updated, unchanged or has an issue.

import.system.col.row.description: Column heading in the import preview table: the row number from the importer.

import.system.commit_done.description: Message shown when an import from another till system has finished and the products are saved; also shown above a warning when some rows had issues.

import.system.connection.description: Accessible label read by screen readers (not visible text) for the list of an importer plugin's secret keys (API key and secret), each shown only as set or not set.

import.system.count.issues.description: Count label in an import result: rows that could not be imported because of a problem.

import.system.count.new.description: Count label in an import result: products that will be (or were) added.

import.system.count.unchanged.description: Count label in an import result: products that already match and are left as they are.

import.system.count.updated.description: Count label in an import result: existing products that will be (or were) changed.

import.system.error.bad_answer.description: Error when the importer plugin's reply can't be read; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.declined.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped and gave a reason, for example wrong API keys.
placeholders: the reason the importer plugin gave, in its own words

import.system.error.declined_silent.description: Error when the importer plugin stopped without giving a reason; points the user to the connection settings.

import.system.error.failed.description: Error when the import could not be completed for an unexpected reason; nothing was saved.

import.system.error.no_entities.description: Error when the importer plugin has not been granted permission to add products.

import.system.error.no_response.description: Error when the importer plugin did not answer in time, usually because the till is offline.

import.system.error.not_found.description: Error when the chosen importer plugin was removed while the page was open.

import.system.error.partial.description: Error when an import stopped part-way; tells the user how many products were saved and that running it again is safe.
placeholders: number of products saved before the import stopped

import.system.error.preview_failed.description: Error when the import preview could not be built.

import.system.error.refused.description: Error when the till rejected the product rows the importer plugin sent; nothing was saved.

import.system.get_importer.description: Link to the plugin store's import category, shown when no importer plugin is installed.

import.system.help.description: Explanation at the top of the 'From another till system' import section: what an importer plugin does, that preview saves nothing and that re-running is safe.

import.system.none.description: Empty state when no importer plugin for another till system is installed; says what to do next.

import.system.plugin_message.description: Shows a message the importer plugin returned, for example the name of the connected account.
placeholders: the message text the importer plugin returned

import.system.preview.description: Button that fetches products from the other till system and shows what would be imported, without saving anything.

import.system.preview_done.description: Message above the import preview: nothing is saved until the user presses Import.

import.system.run_again.description: Button that repeats an import that stopped part-way; already imported products are not duplicated.

import.system.samples.description: Heading above the table of example rows from the import preview.

import.system.settings_link.description: Link to the importer plugin's settings page, where the shop enters its API key and secret.

import.system.title.description: Heading of the import page section that imports products from another till system through an installed importer plugin.

import.welcome.system.action.description: Button on the import page's welcome card that opens the 'From another till system' section.

import.welcome.system.body.description: Text on the import page's welcome card explaining importing straight from the shop's old till system account, with a preview first.

import.welcome.system.title.description: Title of the import page's welcome card for importing from another till system.

plugins.settings.error.choice.description: Error under a plugin settings dropdown when the saved choice is not one of its options. Shown in red under the field; nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.error.max.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the value is above the plugin's allowed maximum. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the largest allowed value, already formatted for the shop (a number, a percentage such as 50.00% or an amount with its currency such as £100.00)

plugins.settings.error.min.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the value is below the plugin's allowed minimum. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the smallest allowed value, already formatted for the shop (a number, a percentage such as 5.00% or an amount with its currency such as £1.00)

plugins.settings.error.number.description: Error under a plugin settings number, percentage or amount field when the typed text is not a number in the accepted format (a whole number, or a decimal with a dot or comma for a percentage or amount). Nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.error.required.description: Error under a plugin settings field the plugin marks as required, when it was left empty. Nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.options_empty.description: Hint under a plugin settings dropdown whose list the plugin supplies, when the plugin offered no choices (for example before an API key is saved). Not an error; Save still works.

plugins.settings.options_failed.description: Note under a plugin settings dropdown whose list the plugin supplies, when asking the plugin failed (timeout, offline, error). Shown next to a Try again button; the stored value stays selectable.

plugins.settings.options_loading.description: Short line beside a plugin settings dropdown whose list the plugin supplies, shown only if the plugin takes longer than a moment to answer.

plugins.settings.options_retry.description: Button under a plugin settings dropdown whose list the plugin supplies, shown after the list failed to load; asks the plugin for the choices again.

plugins.settings.options_saved_missing.description: Hint under a plugin settings dropdown whose list the plugin supplies, when the choice saved earlier is not among the choices the plugin now offers (for example a retired model). The saved value is kept.

plugins.settings.error.stored_invalid.description: Note under a plugin settings field whose already-saved value doesn't fit the field (for example the plugin changed the field from text to a number). The value is shown as it is and is not changed unless the user edits it.

plugins.settings.error.summary.description: Message next to the Save button of a plugin's settings when the save was refused because one or more fields are invalid; each bad field shows its own error.

plugins.settings.error.too_long.description: Error under a plugin settings text field when the text is longer than the plugin allows. Nothing was saved.
placeholders: the maximum number of characters allowed (a number)

plugins.settings.error.url.description: Error under a plugin settings web-address field when the value isn't an http or https address. Keep http://, https:// and the example address unchanged. Nothing was saved.

plugins.settings.tab.errors.description: Accessible name (read by screen readers, shown as a tooltip) of the warning badge on a section of a plugin's settings page when the save was refused because fields in that section are invalid. The badge itself shows a warning sign and the number.
placeholders: how many fields in the section are invalid (a number)

plugins.settings.tab.general.description: Title of the section of a plugin's settings page that holds the settings the plugin did not put in a section of its own. It is shown first, before the plugin's own sections.

plugins.settings.tab.list.description: Accessible name (read by screen readers, not shown) of the row of section tabs on a plugin's settings page.

pos.gift_voucher.in_store_only.description: One-line note under the card number field of the gift voucher popup: a voucher sold here can be spent in this shop only, never in a web shop or online. Keep it short and plain.

pos.scan_choice.customer.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a customer or loyalty card. The customer's name is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.item.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a catalog item (product). The item's name and price are shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.promo.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a promotion or discount code. The code is shown under it.

basket.discount_too_large.description: Sale screen basket: shown under a line's discount box when the cashier enters a discount (or lowers the quantity) so the discount would be more than the line's total. The change is not applied.
placeholders: the line's total, the most the discount can be (an amount of money with currency)

basket.line_changed.description: Sale screen basket: shown under a line (or above the totals when the line no longer exists) when the cashier's quantity or discount change was not applied because the same line changed (or was removed) in the meantime, for example from another screen or a quick second tap. Nothing was charged or recorded by this edit.

pos.toast.line_discount_too_large.description: Sale screen error toast: the sale was not completed because one basket line still has a discount larger than its line total. Nothing was charged; the cashier lowers that line's discount.
placeholders: the name of the item on that basket line

pos.error.void_voucher_additional_till.description: Error when a manager voids a sale on an additional till and the sale sold or topped up a gift voucher. The void is refused and nothing changes.

pos.scan_choice.receipt.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is the number of an earlier receipt (sale), which opens its refund. The receipt number is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.title.description: Heading of the sale-screen chooser shown when one scanned or typed code matches more than one thing (e.g. an item and a gift voucher). It asks the cashier which one they meant.

pos.scan_choice.voucher.description: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a gift voucher number. The voucher number and remaining balance are shown under it.

reports.days.last_24h.description: Reports page, Custom range: the option in the 'number of days' dropdown that shows the rolling last 24 hours up to now (not the business day, which is the Today chip). Sits in a narrow select.

reports.zpaper.articles_more.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the top items when the list is cut short; the full list is on the screen.
placeholders: how many more items are not printed (a number)

reports.zpaper.by_article.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_article_group.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per item category. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_department.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per department (top-level category). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_operator.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per cashier. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_order_type.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales split into eat-in and takeaway. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.by_till.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the sales per till (register). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cash.calculated.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the cash the drawer should hold. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.cash_sales.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken for sales. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.new_float.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash left in the drawer for the next shift. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.opening_float.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash in the drawer when the shift opened. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_ins.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash put into the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.pay_outs.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash taken out of the drawer outside a sale. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.cash.tips_held_out.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: cash tips kept apart from the shop's takings. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also the row label of the on-screen X report's cash breakdown on the Shifts page. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).

reports.zpaper.cash.title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the cash drawer count against the expected cash. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.cleared_baskets.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: shopping baskets the cashier cleared with New sale before taking payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before the baskets' total amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).
placeholders: the number of cleared baskets

reports.zpaper.cleared_title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the section counting shopping baskets cleared with New sale before payment (no sale happened, not in revenue). A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.end_of_day.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the period line of an older day-based report.
placeholders: the business day, as YYYY-MM-DD

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.match.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count matches the till's.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.mismatch.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the device's receipt count differs from the till's.
placeholders: the device's receipt count (a number)
the till's payment count on the device (a number)

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.no_activity.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device recorded nothing and the till sent nothing to it in this period.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.other.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: count of other fiscal device slips. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.serial.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's serial number (row label).

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.till_tender.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: how many payments the till sent to the fiscal device (ÖKC). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before a count; a longer label is cut short on paper.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.title.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: heading of the Turkish fiscal device (ÖKC) check. Keep 'OKC'/'ÖKC' as it is. A section heading, printed in capitals where the language has them.

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_closed_mi.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: after the device's Z numbers when it closed its own day inside this period. At most 30 characters with the numbers left out, so the Z numbers still fit the 42-column paper.
placeholders: the device's Z report numbers, comma-separated

reports.zpaper.fiscal_device.z_no.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the fiscal device's own Z report number(s) (row label). 'Z' stays as it is.

reports.zpaper.receipts_range.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: the first and last receipt numbers in this period. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).
placeholders: the first receipt number
the last receipt number

reports.zpaper.restored_receipts.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer, first report after a backup restore: where receipt numbers continue, and the last receipt number the backup held (a dash when it held none).
placeholders: the receipt number the till continues at
the last receipt number in the restored backup

reports.zpaper.restored_z.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer, first report after a backup restore: the Z number this report carries, and the last Z number the backup held.
placeholders: the Z number this report continues at
the last Z number in the restored backup

reports.zpaper.stornos_note.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: explanation in brackets after the fixed German heading STORNOS. At most 31 characters: the whole line must fit 42.

reports.zpaper.voided.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: completed sales cancelled afterwards. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper. Also printed on the X report (Shifts page).
placeholders: the number of voided receipts

reports.zpaper.vouchers_adjusted.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift voucher balances corrected by a manager. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.
placeholders: the number of corrections

reports.zpaper.vouchers_imported.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers brought in from another system (opening balances). Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.
placeholders: the number of vouchers

reports.zpaper.vouchers_issued.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers sold in this period, under the fixed heading GUTSCHEINE. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.
placeholders: the number of vouchers

reports.zpaper.vouchers_redeemed.description: Printed end-of-day (Z) report on the receipt printer: gift vouchers used to pay in this period. Printed as a row label in a 20-character column before an amount; a longer label is cut short on paper.
placeholders: the number of redemptions

help.support_partner.scan.description: Caption above the QR code and link on the Support partner help topic (shown only on a registered till): scanning opens my.universaltill.com Manage shop → Support partner. Also the QR image alt text. Keep the screen names consistent with the my. site.

settings.currency_display.auto.description: Option in the currency display choice: the product picks symbol or code per currency.

settings.currency_display.code.description: Option in the currency display choice: always write the three-letter currency code (for example GBP).

settings.currency_display.help.description: Help line under the currency display choice; says what the three options do and that receipts fall back to the code when the printer cannot print the symbol.

settings.currency_display.symbol.description: Option in the currency display choice: always write the currency symbol (for example the pound sign).

settings.currency_display.title.description: Heading of the Settings card choice that sets how amounts write the shop currency (symbol, code or automatic).

settings.staff_links.help.description: Muted line under the 'Users and permissions' card in Settings → Staff & security, introducing the links to the Users and Permissions pages.

settings.staff_links.title.description: Heading of the card in Settings → Staff & security that links to the Users page (staff accounts and PINs) and the Permissions page; also its entry in the settings sidebar.

settings.enrol.linked.description: Status line on Settings → Till registration once the shop is claimed: the till's store is already linked to the owner's Universal Till ID, so there is no Claim button.

settings.enrol.linked_manage.description: Link under the linked-store line in Settings → Till registration; opens My stores on my.universaltill.com. 'My stores' is that page's name there.

settings.enrol.claim_unauthorized.description: Error line under the Claim this store button in Settings when the cloud refused this till's credential (HTTP 401): says the till is not connected right now and is reconnecting by itself; never blames the internet connection.

settings.enrol.reconnect_title.description: Summary (the tap row that opens the Pair form) in Settings → Till registration for a shop that is already linked. Pair form re-connects this one till to a shop's cloud account.

settings.enrol.pair_help_2.description: Explanation under the Pair with a shop heading in Settings → Till registration. The two quoted names are the exact button labels on my.universaltill.com (Pair a till / Pair again); translators should use the my. translations of those labels.

settings.enrol.pair_identity_pinned.description: Error shown under Settings → Pair with a shop when the till's cloud identity is fixed by UT_MARKETPLACE_* environment variables, so the pairing code was not used and a new code will not help.

settings.enrol.pair_replace_title.description: Heading of the confirmation shown after pressing Pair under Settings → Pair with a shop on a till that is already connected to a shop's cloud account.

settings.enrol.pair_replace_body.description: Body of that confirmation: what replacing the connection means and the risk of a wrong code; no compliance claims. 1st placeholder: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set; 2nd: the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted. Keep both placeholders; the till wraps each in bidi isolates.
placeholders: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set
the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted (keep as is)

settings.enrol.pair_replace_confirm.description: Primary (red) button of that confirmation; pairs this till with the code, replacing its current cloud connection (Cancel is common.cancel).

settings.enrol.terms.accepted.description: Muted line in Settings and the setup wizard once the operator has accepted the current Merchant Terms. 1st placeholder: the terms version (e.g. merchant-terms-v1.0, keep as is); 2nd: the date accepted (YYYY-MM-DD).
placeholders: the terms version identifier, e.g. v0.1-draft
the date the terms were accepted (YYYY-MM-DD)

settings.enrol.terms.label.description: Label of the checkbox the operator ticks to accept the Universal Till Merchant Terms before the till registers with the cloud (consent wording: translate faithfully, do not soften or add claims).
placeholders: the terms version identifier, e.g. v0.1-draft

settings.enrol.terms.link.description: Link next to the terms checkbox that opens the cloud service terms page in a new tab.

settings.enrol.terms_required.description: Error shown when the operator tries to register the till (or turn on automatic registration) without ticking the cloud service terms checkbox; nothing was sent.

elevation.error_approval_changed.description: Error line in the manager-PIN prompt shown when the request changed since the prompt was shown, was already approved once, or the approval timed out or was lost after a till restart; the prompt is shown again for the values now requested.

elevation.error_approval_changed_api.description: Error message in the JSON response of an integration request (void a sale, open the drawer without a sale) when the approval token it sent was already used, expired, lost after a till restart, or was issued for different values; the response carries a fresh approval token to retry with. Not shown on the till screen.

elevation.summary.reduce_line_qty.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier lowers a priced basket line's quantity (the minus button, the quantity box, or zero): it names the item, the old and new quantity and the void/comp/waste reason the approver is allowing.
placeholders: item name
current quantity
new quantity
reason (void, comp or waste)

elevation.summary.line_discount.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier raises the discount on a priced basket line: it names the item and the old and new discount amounts the approver is allowing.
placeholders: item name
current discount amount
new discount amount

elevation.summary.sale_discount.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier raises the sale-level discount: it names the old and new discount amounts the approver is allowing.
placeholders: current discount amount
new discount amount

elevation.summary.refund.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier without the Refunds permission presses Refund: it names the refund total, the original receipt number and the payment method the money goes back to, so the approver sees exactly what they allow. The payment method is its on-screen name (e.g. Cash, Card), not a code.
placeholders: refund total
receipt number
payment method display name

elevation.summary.clear_sale.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier presses New sale on a basket that still holds priced items: it says how many lines and what total would be thrown away.
placeholders: number of lines
basket total

permissions.action.price_override.description: Permissions page, Sales group: name of the permission that lets a role raise a line or sale discount by hand without a manager PIN (promo codes never ask).

permissions.action_desc.price_override.description: Permissions page: one-line description under the Discounts permission, saying that without it raising a discount by hand asks for a manager PIN, and that promo codes never ask.

pos.error.discount_not_permitted.description: Error returned to an integration that sends a sale discount above the basket's own discount to the tender, sale-discount or line endpoint, from a session that may not discount; nothing is applied.

basket.sale_changed.description: Note under the basket when a manager-approved discount or New sale was refused because the sale changed while the approval was being entered; nothing was applied.

elevation.summary.enrol_terms.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier presses Accept terms (or Send to the cloud) under Settings → Till registration for an already registered till: it names the action the approver is allowing.

elevation.summary.x_report_print.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier prints the X report on the Shifts page: names the register whose figures the approver is allowing to be printed.
placeholders: the register's name

elevation.summary.eod_day_x.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier opens the day-so-far X report on Reports, End of day: says the approver is allowing all sales since the last day close to be shown.

elevation.summary.eod_day_x_print.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier prints the day-so-far X report on Reports, End of day: says the approver is allowing all sales since the last day close to be printed.

shifts.close_slip.print.description: Shifts page, close result: label of the button that prints the shift close slip on the receipt printer after a shift has been closed.

shifts.close_slip.printing.description: Shifts page, close result: short status beside the Print shift slip button while the print request runs (up to 15 seconds).

shifts.close_slip.print_ok.description: Shifts page, close result: confirmation beside the Print shift slip button once the receipt printer accepted the slip.

shifts.close_slip.print_failed.description: Shifts page, close result: error beside the Print shift slip button (close result) or the Print slip button (History row) when the receipt printer is off, not set up or did not answer. Names the Receipt printer settings section, so keep that name identical to its translation; it names no button.

shifts.close_slip.not_closed.description: Error when a shift slip is requested for a shift that is unknown or still open (for example a stale page). Tells the operator to reload.

shifts.close_slip.invalid_request.description: Error when the shift slip print request could not be read (malformed or too large).

shifts.close_slip.failed.description: Error when the shift slip could not be prepared because of an unexpected fault; tells the operator to try again; names no button.

shifts.close_slip.paper.title.description: Printed shift close slip on the receipt printer: title line at the top. The close of one shift, never an end-of-day (Z) report. Printed in capitals where the language has them.

shifts.close_slip.paper.section_close.description: Printed shift close slip: heading above the drawer count figures (expected, counted, variance, skim, new float).

shifts.close_slip.paper.reprinted.description: Printed shift close slip, only when printed again from the History list on the Shifts page: line after the Generated line marking the slip as a reprint. %s is the date and time of the reprint.
placeholders: date and time of the reprint

shifts.close_slip.print_row.description: Shifts page, History list: label of the button on each closed shift row that prints that shift's close slip again on the receipt printer.

shifts.count_detail.show.description: Button in a closed shift's row of the Shifts history table; loads that shift's stored coin-and-note count into the panel below the table.

shifts.count_detail.title.description: Heading of the panel under the Shifts history table that shows one closed shift's coin-and-note count.

shifts.count_detail.hint.description: Line under the panel heading on the Shifts page, shown before any count is loaded; says what the panel is for and how to fill it.

shifts.count_detail.hide.description: Button in the loaded denomination count panel on the Shifts page that empties the panel again.

shifts.count_detail.denomination.description: Column header in the stored count: the value of one coin or note.

shifts.count_detail.pieces.description: Column header in the stored count: how many of that coin or note were counted.

shifts.count_detail.total.description: Row label in the stored count: the sum of all coin and note lines.
