shifts.count_detail.none.description: Shown when a closed shift was closed without the optional coin-and-note count.

shifts.count_detail.partial.description: Note under a stored count when some entries were unreadable (damaged or invalid data) and left out.

shifts.count_detail.unreadable.description: Shown instead of the table when the stored coin-and-note count is damaged and nothing in it can be read.

shifts.count_detail.mismatch.description: Neutral note when the counted-cash figure typed at close is not equal to the total of the coin-and-note count. Information only, not an error.

shifts.count_detail.not_closed.description: Error when the count is requested for an unknown or still-open shift (for example a stale page). Tells the operator to reload.

shifts.count_detail.invalid_request.description: Error when the count request could not be read (shift id too long).

shifts.count_detail.failed.description: Error after an unexpected fault while loading the count; the button named is the key shifts.count_detail.show.

elevation.summary.shift_slip_print.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier prints the shift close slip after closing a shift: names the register whose shift the approver is allowing to be printed.
placeholders: the register's name

elevation.summary.x_report.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier opens the X report on the Shifts page: names the register the approver is allowing the cashier to view.
placeholders: the register's name

settings.enrol.terms.accept_btn.description: Button under Settings → Till registration (already registered till, cloud terms not yet accepted) that records the ticked acceptance of the cloud service terms and sends it to the cloud.

settings.enrol.terms.send_btn.description: Button under Settings → Till registration, shown when the cloud service terms are accepted on this till but the acceptance has not reached the cloud yet; it sends it again.

settings.enrol.terms.unsent.description: Muted note under Settings → Till registration: the cloud service terms were accepted on this till, but the acceptance has not yet been delivered to the cloud (for example the till was offline).

settings.enrol.terms.send_failed.description: Error shown after Accept terms / Send to the cloud when the cloud could not be reached. The acceptance is kept on this till and the operator can try again; nothing else is affected.

settings.enrol.terms.accept_required.description: Error shown when the operator presses Accept terms on an already registered till without ticking the cloud service terms checkbox; nothing was recorded or sent.

settings.lan.help.description: Explanation under Settings → Allow other tills on this network: a desktop main till talks only to this computer until the shop lets other tills in; what Automatic, Always and Never mean; what other devices can reach even when open.

settings.lan.mode.auto.description: Button label: other tills are let in for 10 minutes after a pairing code is shown, and always while the shop has more than one till.

settings.lan.mode.off.description: Button label: no other device on the network may reach this till (this computer only).

settings.lan.mode.on.description: Button label: other tills on the network may always reach this till.

settings.lan.saved.description: Status note after the network-access choice is stored.

settings.lan.title.description: Heading of the Settings control that decides whether other tills on the network may reach this desktop till.

settings.language.download_group.description: Label of the group in Settings → Language's language list holding languages not installed yet, which download from the plugin catalog when picked.

settings.language.downloads_on_select.description: Note under Settings → Language: a language from the download group installs in the background when applied, and the till switches to it once it has arrived.

settings.language.install_unavailable.description: Status chip on Settings → Language when a picked language left the download queue without arriving (not in the catalog, or removed under Settings → Data). The till's language is unchanged.
placeholders: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

settings.language.installing.description: Status chip on Settings → Language while a picked language downloads in the background.
placeholders: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

settings.language.switching.description: Status chip on Settings → Language when the picked language has finished downloading and the till is switching to it.
placeholders: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

status.update_available_ask_manager.description: Status bar pill on an Android till for a signed-in person who cannot open Settings (a cashier): a newer version exists and a manager must install it. Shown after the words "Update available" and the version number ("Update available v1.2.3 — ask a manager"), never a button.

settings.update.android.banner_title.description: Accessible name of the banner at the top of Settings on an Android till when a newer version can be installed.

settings.update.android.banner_version.description: Headline of the banner at the top of Settings on an Android till: a newer version exists.
placeholders: version number of the update, without a leading v

settings.update.android.banner_body.description: Explains the Android update banner: current version, how long installing takes, and a warning to finish open sales first.
placeholders: version number this till runs now, without a leading v

settings.update.android.banner_action.description: Button in the Android update banner on Settings that scrolls to the install controls.

settings.update.android.allow_title.description: Heading of the panel in Settings (Android till) shown when Android has not yet allowed this app to install its own updates.

settings.update.android.allow_body.description: Tells the manager what to do on Android's own 'install unknown apps' screen. The quoted switch names are Android's wording and may differ by device or language.

settings.update.android.allow_open.description: Button that opens Android's 'install unknown apps' screen for this app.

settings.update.android.allow_later.description: Button that hides the install-permission panel; the update stays available.

settings.update.android.allow_granted.description: Shown after the manager came back from Android's settings with the install permission switched on.

settings.update.android.download_window.description: Muted line under the update time in Settings → Software update on a sideloaded Android main/standalone till with automatic updates on: the nightly window (the saved update time plus this till's own offset, 30 minutes long) in which the till downloads and verifies the new app version, only while the app is open on screen; it never installs by itself — a manager installs with a tap at any time no sale or order is open. Tells the manager: the window, that the app must be open on screen in it, and that installing is a manager's tap, never automatic.
placeholders: start of this till's nightly download window, HH:MM, e.g. 03:07
end of that window, HH:MM, e.g. 03:37

settings.update.android.allow_still_deni.description: Shown after the manager came back from Android's settings and the install permission is still off.

settings.update.android.install_again.description: Android in-app update: shown on the update button (status-bar chip, Settings → Software update, the check-for-updates result) when Android's installer was opened but closed again or never came up on screen. Tapping the button opens the installer again with the app already downloaded.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_confir.description: Label of a required tick box in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales. Ticking it confirms that linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces this till's sales, products and settings with the main till's copy.

tills.discovery.ambient.has_sales_warnin.description: Warning in the 'found a main till on this network' notice and above the join tabs on the Tills page, shown only when this till already has sales: linking (or joining with a pairing code) replaces everything on this till with the main till's copy, and this till's own sales are not sent to the main till (a copy stays in this till's backups folder). Also the error shown when a join is attempted without ticking the confirm box.

tills.discovery.result_name.description: Label before a main till's LAN identifier (a UUID). Shown in the 'Find a main till on this network' results (Tills page and setup wizard) and on the Tills page's main-till row, so an operator can check the till found in the scan is the right device. Both places must use the same word.

tills.join_error.main_no_tls.description: Error shown under the join or pairing form on a satellite-to-be when the main till refuses a plain-HTTP join because it cannot serve a secure connection at all. Tells the person to restart the main till and try again.

tills.join_error.satellite_tls_only.description: Error shown under the join or pairing form when a satellite could not join because this till could not make a secure connection to the main till. Tells the person to update this till if it runs an older version than the main till, otherwise to restart both tills, then try again.

tills.join_error.tls_only.description: Error shown under the join or pairing form when the main till only accepts secure connections and this till could not make one. Tells the person to update this till if it runs an older version than the main till, otherwise to restart both tills, then try again.

translations.mode.title.description: Name of the manager-only view mode that shows each on-screen text's translation key. Card title on the translation editor and label in the status bar.

translations.mode.intro.description: Explanation on the translation editor's Translate mode card: what the mode does and how to open a text's panel.

translations.mode.turn_on.description: Button on the translation editor that turns translate mode on for this browser.

translations.mode.turn_off.description: Button that turns translate mode off (status bar and translation editor).

translations.mode.hint.description: Short reminder in the status bar while translate mode is on: how to open a text's panel. 'Alt' is the keyboard key; keep it as on the keyboard.

translations.mode.refused_kiosk.description: Error when someone tries to turn on translate mode on a till set up as a customer self-order kiosk.

translations.mode.unknown_key.description: Message in the translate-mode panel when the pressed text's key is not known to the till.

translations.mode.panel_title.description: Title of the side panel that opens when a manager Alt+clicks or long-presses a text in translate mode.

translations.mode.other_keys.description: Lead-in above a list of text keys, when the pressed element shows several texts (for example a label and its tooltip).

translations.mode.key.description: Label for the text's translation key (its technical identifier) in the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.area.description: Label for the part of the till the text belongs to (sale, catalog, settings...), which is also its group in the translation service.

translations.mode.description.description: Label for the note that tells translators where and how the text is used.

translations.mode.no_description.description: Shown in the translate-mode panel when the text has no translator note yet.

translations.mode.placeholders.description: Label for the list of values the till fills into the text (a name, an amount...).

translations.mode.max_length.description: Label for the most characters a translation of this text may have; the number follows it.

translations.mode.current.description: Label for the text as the till shows it now, in the current language (the language code follows in brackets).

translations.mode.english.description: Label for the English source text, shown under the current language's text when they differ.

translations.mode.weblate_title.description: Heading of the panel section that links the text to the shared translation service (Weblate).

translations.mode.open_weblate.description: Link that opens this text in the Weblate translation service in a new tab. Weblate is a product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.qr_alt.description: Screen-reader description of the QR code image. Weblate is a product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.qr_hint.description: Hint under the QR code: scanning it opens the same link on a phone or another computer.

translations.mode.plugin_key.description: Shown instead of the Weblate link when the text belongs to an installed plugin rather than the till itself.

translations.mode.override_title.description: Heading of the panel section where a manager changes the wording on this till only (the same overrides as the translation editor).

translations.mode.override_help.description: Explanation under the Shop override heading. 'Reset' refers to the Reset button (translations.reset).

translations.mode.saved.description: Confirmation after a shop override is saved from the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.reset_done.description: Confirmation after a shop override is removed from the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.empty.description: Error when Save is pressed with an empty override field.

translations.mode.reload.description: Button that reloads the page so a saved override shows.

translations.mode.page_areas.description: Heading of the list of areas (groups in the translation service) that the texts on the current page belong to.

translations.mode.page_areas_help.description: Explanation under 'Areas on this page': these are the translation-service groups to invite a translator to.

settings.tills.main_till_addr.description: Line on a joined till's Settings Tills card giving the network address of the main till it follows.
placeholders: network address of the main till, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080

settings.tills.role_label.description: Label in front of this till's role on the Settings Tills card (This till: Main till).

settings.tills.role_main.description: This till's role when it is the shop's main till (the one other tills join), shown after the 'This till' label.

status.shop_currency_mismatch.hint.description: Status-bar chip title (tooltip), shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. (the cloud portal; a product name, keep 'my.' as is) and the till did not switch by itself (it already has sales, or this till version does not know that currency). Explains both currencies and that the manager changes it in Settings.
placeholders: the till's currency code, e.g. GBP
the shop's currency code on my., e.g. EUR

status.shop_currency_mismatch.label.description: Status-bar chip label, shown to a manager when this till's currency differs from the shop's currency on my. Short: it sits in the status bar.

setup.join.role_main.description: Third 'Join as' choice on the wizard's join screen: this till becomes the first, main till of a shop already set up on my.universaltill.com.

setup.join.main_help.description: Help text under the 'Main till' choice of 'Join as'.

setup.cloud.code_help.description: Instruction above the pairing-code field when joining as the main till. Names the my.universaltill.com screens (Tills, Add a till); keep those names consistent with the my. site.

tills.join_error.cloud_code.description: Error under the Additional till / Satellite join form when the 8-character my.universaltill.com shop code is typed there. Names the screens: Settings, Tills, Show pairing code; keep consistent.

setup.cloud.error.main_till_code.description: Error under the Main till join form when a main till's own 6-character code is typed there.

setup.cloud.error.device_exists.description: Error when the cloud says this device already has a credential (409 device_exists).

setup.cloud.error.device_removed.description: Error when the cloud says this device was removed from the shop (409 device_revoked).

setup.cloud.pair_btn.description: Button that sends the my.universaltill.com pairing code.

setup.cloud.title.description: Title of the wizard step that shows the shop details taken from my.universaltill.com after pairing.

setup.cloud.hint.description: Explanation under the shop details after pairing.

setup.cloud.shop_name.description: Label of the shop name on the 'Your shop' step.

setup.cloud.shop_country.description: Label of the country on the 'Your shop' step.

setup.cloud.shop_currency.description: Label of the currency on the 'Your shop' step.

setup.cloud.shop_type.description: Label of the shop type (café, retail, ...) on the 'Your shop' step, shown when the shop type was chosen on my.universaltill.com.

setup.cloud.continue.description: Button that accepts the shop details on the 'Your shop' step.

setup.cloud.not_mine.description: Button that drops the pairing and returns to the first step.

setup.cloud.pair_incomplete.description: Note on the welcome page when the wizard could not save the cloud pairing: the code is spent, so the till is not syncing; pair again with a new code in Settings, Tills.

setup.cloud.syncing.description: Status chip on the welcome page right after a till paired with the cloud shop in setup; the first sync runs in the background.

setup.cloud.syncing_title.description: Heading of the syncing state a till shows after joining a cloud shop, while the shop's products are still being received.

setup.cloud.syncing_body.description: Body of the syncing state after joining a cloud shop: products are arriving, the sale screen opens by itself, selling can start now.

setup.cloud.error.invalid_code.description: Inline error: the pairing code was refused (wrong, used or expired).

setup.cloud.error.too_many.description: Inline error: the cloud or this till rate-limited the pairing attempts (HTTP 429).

setup.cloud.error.no_network.description: Inline error: pairing needs the internet and none was reachable.

setup.cloud.error.unavailable.description: Inline error: no cloud endpoint is configured, or the cloud identity is fixed by the environment.

setup.cloud.error.failed.description: Inline error: any other pairing failure.

setup.cloud.error.expired.description: Wizard error when the held pairing is gone (30 minutes passed or the till restarted) at the final step.

setup.cloud.error.unnamed_till.description: Stands in for the name of the shop's existing till when the cloud has none; used inside the 'shop already has a till' message.

setup.cloud.error.store_has_main_till.description: Inline error in the setup wizard (Join an existing shop, Main till): the shop on my.universaltill.com already has a live main till. Says how to replace it (my. Tills page, 'Replace this till', a new code) or join as another till. 'Additional till' and 'Satellite' are the role choices above the field; keep them as the till's own labels for those roles.
placeholders: the existing main till's name
when it was last seen (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC)

setup.cloud.replace.title.description: Heading of the setup wizard's confirmation when a replace code is typed: this new device would replace the shop's main till.
placeholders: the name of the main till being replaced

setup.cloud.replace.body.description: Body of the replace confirmation in the setup wizard: what happens to the old main till and this one.
placeholders: the name of the main till being replaced
when it was last seen (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC)

setup.cloud.replace.loss.description: Bold warning in the replace confirmation: the old till's sales after it was last seen never reached the cloud and are lost.
placeholders: the name of the main till being replaced
when it was last seen (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC)

setup.cloud.replace.copies_cloud.description: Replace confirmation, shops whose products are kept in the cloud: what the new main till copies and what must be set up again.

setup.cloud.replace.copies_till_master.description: Replace confirmation, shops whose plan keeps the products on the till only: the new till starts with sample products.

setup.cloud.replace.backup.description: Replace confirmation hint: the cloud never holds sales, customers or PINs; only a backup file of the old till brings them back (Settings, Backups after setup).
placeholders: the name of the main till being replaced

setup.cloud.replace.confirm.description: Danger button that confirms replacing the shop's main till with this device. Wraps on small screens.
placeholders: the name of the main till being replaced

setup.cloud.replaced_note.description: Line on the setup wizard's 'Your shop' step after this till replaced the shop's main till; names the old till.
placeholders: the name of the main till this one replaced

setup.next_steps.title.description: Heading of the dismissible card on the sale screen after a till was set up from the shop's cloud account (my.), listing what is not copied to a new till.

setup.next_steps.pins.description: Next-steps line: staff PINs are never copied to a new till; links to Users.

setup.next_steps.devices.description: Next-steps line: payment terminal and printer are set up per device; links to Settings.

setup.next_steps.stock.description: Next-steps line: stock on hand is not copied; links to Inventory.

setup.next_steps.no_catalog.description: Next-steps line, only on a plan where the till masters the catalogue: products were not copied; links to Import. "Catalog" is the nav.catalog label.

setup.next_steps.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the ✕ that removes the Next steps card for good on this till.

setup.cloud.error.main_till_online.description: Inline error after confirming a replacement: the old main till talked to the cloud in the last 15 minutes, so it cannot be replaced yet.
placeholders: when the old till was last seen (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC)

setup.cloud.error.replace_target_changed.description: Inline error after confirming a replacement: the cloud's replace code no longer matches the till being replaced.

setup.cloud.error.replace_needs_owner.description: Inline error: an ordinary 'Add a till' code was used to confirm a replacement; only the owner's replace code can replace the main till.

setup.cloud.error.replace_main_till_only.description: Inline error: a replace code was used anywhere but the setup wizard's Main till choice.

setup.cloud.error.replace_unsupported.description: Inline error: the till confirmed a replacement but the cloud answered as if it had not (a cloud that cannot replace yet). Gives the manual way round: remove the old till on my. and pair with an ordinary 'Add a till' code.

status.cloud_auth.replaced.description: Status-bar chip on a till the shop's owner replaced as main till on my.universaltill.com. Names the till that replaced it.
placeholders: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.cloud_auth.replaced_hint.description: Tooltip of the 'Replaced by' chip: when the till was replaced and that its sales go nowhere.
placeholders: the date it was replaced (YYYY-MM-DD)
the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.cloud_auth.restored.description: Status-bar chip on a till whose data was restored from a phone or iCloud backup onto a new device: its cloud connection was reset and it must be connected again.

status.cloud_auth.restored_hint.description: Tooltip of the 'Restored on a new device' chip: the cloud connection was reset, the old device keeps its own, and the manager can pair again or register as a new store in Settings; selling continues.

status.cloud_heal.reconnecting.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  while a till reconnects by itself; no action needed and selling is unaffected.

status.cloud_heal.reconnected.description: One-time notice after a till reconnected to its shop by itself.

status.cloud_heal.waiting.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  when a till must wait for a date (a new key is not yet trusted, or a daily limit was reached) before it reconnects by itself.
placeholders: the date and time it reconnects

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till that cannot prove its identity to its shop's cloud account; the owner makes a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove_no_accoun.description: Status-bar chip on a till that cannot prove its identity and whose shop has no owner account to make a code.

status.cloud_heal.removed.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till the owner removed from the shop's cloud account on purpose; sales stay on the till.

status.cloud_heal.replaced.description: Status-bar chip on a till the owner replaced as main till; it can still sell offline.
placeholders: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.replaced_full.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till the owner replaced as main till; it can still sell offline.
placeholders: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.moved.description: Status-bar chip on a till that was moved to another shop's account.
placeholders: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.moved_full.description: Full sentence (chip tooltip, Tills banner, Settings notice)  on a till that was moved to another shop's account.
placeholders: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.shop_deleted.description: Status-bar chip on a till whose shop was deleted from its cloud account.

status.cloud_heal.role_conflict.description: Status-bar chip on a till that cannot reconnect with its old role because another till is the main till.

status.cloud_heal.in_use_elsewhere.description: Status-bar chip when the same till data seems to run on two devices, so reconnecting by itself is paused.

status.cloud_heal.unnamed_shop.description: Fallback name in the 'now belongs to' chip when the cloud did not give the other shop's name.

status.cloud_heal.btn_code.description: Link in the status-bar chip that opens this till's page to connect with a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.btn_new_shop.description: Link in the status-bar chip that opens Settings to register this till as a new shop.

status.cloud_heal.btn_enter_code.description: Link in the status-bar chip that opens this till's page to enter a pairing code.

status.cloud_heal.btn_join.description: Link in the status-bar chip that opens the page to join this till to the shop as an additional till.

status.cloud_heal.btn_open.description: Link in the status-bar chip that opens Settings, Till registration.

status.cloud_heal.ask_manager.description: Added to the status-bar chip's tooltip for a signed-in person who may not open Settings.

status.cloud_heal.in_use_elsewhere_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip when the same till data is in use on two devices.

status.cloud_heal.role_conflict_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that cannot reconnect as the main till because another till is the main till.

status.cloud_heal.shop_deleted_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till whose shop was deleted from its online account.

status.cloud_heal.moved_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that now belongs to another shop.
placeholders: the name of the other shop

status.cloud_heal.replaced_unnamed.description: Sentence for a replaced till when the new main till's name is not known: chip tooltip, Tills page banner and Till registration notice.

status.cloud_heal.replaced_unnamed_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a replaced till when the new main till's name is not known.

status.cloud_heal.replaced_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that another till replaced as the main till.
placeholders: the name of the new main till

status.cloud_heal.removed_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip on a till that was removed from its shop's account.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove_no_accoun.description: Short words in the status-bar chip when a till cannot reconnect by itself and its shop has no online account.

status.cloud_heal.cannot_prove_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip when a till cannot reconnect by itself and the shop owner can make a code.

status.cloud_heal.waiting_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip when a till will reconnect to its shop by itself at a later time.
placeholders: the date and time it reconnects

status.cloud_heal.reconnecting_short.description: Short words in the status-bar chip while a till gets a new connection to its shop by itself; the full sentence is the chip's tooltip.

plugins.manage.revoked.description: Chip on a Plugins-page card: the Plugin Store withdrew the installed version and this till turned the plugin off.

plugins.manage.revoked_hint_update.description: Hint under the withdrawal notice on a plugin card that has a newer version: press Update; turning the withdrawn version back on lasts about 30 minutes.

plugins.manage.revoked_hint_no_update.description: Hint under the withdrawal notice on a plugin card with no newer version yet: uninstall or wait; turning the withdrawn version back on lasts about 30 minutes.

plugins.revoked.hint_unknown.description: Hint under the withdrawal notice on a plugin card when the till cannot tell whether a newer version exists (offline, or imported from a file): never claims there is no update.

plugins.manage.broken_code_refused.description: Note on a broken plugin card (and its Broken chip tooltip) on the App Store build, which never downloads or runs plugin code: the plugin will not be reinstalled and can be removed.

plugins.manage.revoked_notice.description: Notice on the card of a plugin turned off because the Plugin Store withdrew its installed version, when no reason was given.
placeholders: plugin version number

plugins.manage.revoked_notice_reason.description: Same notice when the Plugin Store gave a reason; the reason is the store admin's own text, shown untranslated.
placeholders: plugin version number
reason text from the Plugin Store, in its own language

status.move_pending.description: Status-bar chip on every page, the sale screen included, shown to every role (cashiers too) while a request to move this till into another shop waits for a manager's approval. Read-only; names no shop. Short: it sits in the status bar.

status.move_pending_hint.description: Tooltip (title) of the pending-move status chip. Shown to cashiers too, so it names no shop and no deadline.

plugins.settings.secret_unreadable.description: Note under a plugin's secret field (API key, password): a value is saved but cannot be read on this till, for example after a restore onto a new device, so the manager enters it again.

status.replaced_banner.description: Banner on every page of a till the shop's owner replaced as main till; it cannot be dismissed. Selling still works, but those sales reach neither the cloud nor the main till.
placeholders: the name of the new main till, or 'the new main till' when unknown

status.replaced.unnamed.description: Stands in for the new main till's name in the 'Replaced by' chip and banner while the cloud does not know it yet. Lower case: it sits inside a sentence.

tills.join_error.replaced.description: Join error on a till that tried to join a main till the shop's owner has replaced.

tills.pairing.error.this_till_replaced.description: Error on a replaced main till when a manager asks it for a pairing code for another till.

channel_orders.title.description: The page and menu title for orders taken on a web shop or marketplace and recorded on this till.

page.title.channel_orders.description: Browser tab title of the Online orders page.

channel_orders.intro_actions.description: Intro line above the Online orders list. Explains these are not till sales and that the main till (or my.universaltill.com) can accept, ship or cancel them. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

channel_orders.empty.description: Empty state of the Online orders list.

channel_orders.col.number.description: Column heading: the shop-facing order number such as #1001.

channel_orders.col.placed.description: Column heading: when the customer placed the order.

channel_orders.col.channel.description: Column heading: the sales channel (web shop or marketplace) the order came from.

channel_orders.col.status.description: Column heading: the order's progress status.

channel_orders.col.lines.description: Column heading: how many order lines (distinct products) the order has.

channel_orders.col.total.description: Column heading and label: the amount the customer paid for the order.

channel_orders.status.new.description: Order status: placed, not yet accepted.

channel_orders.status.accepted.description: Order status: accepted by the shop.

channel_orders.status.picked.description: Order status: items picked from the shelves.

channel_orders.status.packed.description: Order status: items packed for dispatch.

channel_orders.status.shipped.description: Order status: handed to the carrier.

channel_orders.status.partially_refunded.description: Order status: part of the order was refunded.

channel_orders.payment.pending.description: Payment state reported by the channel: not paid yet.

channel_orders.payment.authorized.description: Payment state reported by the channel: authorised, not yet captured.

channel_orders.payment.paid.description: Payment state reported by the channel: paid.

channel_orders.payment.partially_refunde.description: Payment state reported by the channel: part of the payment was refunded.

channel_orders.payment.refunded.description: Payment state reported by the channel: the payment was refunded.

channel_orders.payment.voided.description: Payment state reported by the channel: the payment was voided.

channel_orders.detail.title.description: Heading of one online order; the order number follows it.

channel_orders.detail.back.description: Link back to the Online orders list.

channel_orders.detail.payment.description: Label: the payment state the channel reports.

channel_orders.detail.country.description: Label: the customer's country. The till stores only the country, never a name or address.

channel_orders.detail.currency_mismatch.description: Warning on an order whose currency differs from the shop currency; the currency code follows in brackets.

channel_orders.detail.total_mismatch.description: Warning on an order whose total does not match the sum of its lines; shown as received.

channel_orders.detail.unmatched_line.description: Chip on an order line that matches no item in this till, so stock was not changed.

channel_orders.detail.col.item.description: Column heading: product name as sold.

channel_orders.detail.col.sku.description: Column heading: stock keeping unit code.

channel_orders.detail.col.price.description: Column heading: price of one unit.

channel_orders.detail.col.discount.description: Column heading on an online order: the discount the customer got on this line, for all its units together (not per unit). Empty when the line had none.

channel_orders.detail.col.refunded.description: Column heading: units refunded or cancelled so far.

channel_orders.detail.col.restocked.description: Column heading: refunded units that went back into stock.

channel_orders.detail.shipping.description: Label: shipping charged on the order.

channel_orders.detail.discount.description: Label: discount not tied to a single line.

channel_orders.detail.items_subtotal.description: Label in an online order's totals: the lines' quantity x unit price added up, before any discount. Shown only when the order has a discount.

channel_orders.detail.line_discounts.description: Label in an online order's totals: the sum of the discounts on its lines. Shown apart from "Order discount", which is a discount not tied to one line.

channel_orders.detail.tax_added.description: Label: tax the channel added on top of tax-exclusive prices.

channel_orders.detail.refunded_total.description: Label: total amount refunded so far.

channel_orders.error.load_failed.description: Error shown when the Online orders list or an order cannot be read.

channel_orders.error.not_found.description: Error shown when an order id is unknown.

channel_orders.actions.heading.description: Heading of the block of buttons on an online order that accept, pack, ship or cancel it.

channel_orders.action.accept.description: Button on an online order: accept the order for the shop.

channel_orders.action.pick.description: Button on an online order: record that the items were picked from the shelves.

channel_orders.action.pack.description: Button on an online order: record that the order is packed.

channel_orders.action.ship.description: Button on an online order: open the form to ship the order with a carrier. The ellipsis means a form opens first.

channel_orders.action.cancel.description: Button on an online order: open the form to cancel the order. The ellipsis means a form opens first.

channel_orders.outcome.accept.description: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.pick.description: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.outcome.pack.description: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.
