channel_orders.outcome.cancel.description: Names the action in the notice about its outcome and on its Dismiss button (screen readers). The same action as the button, without the ellipsis.

channel_orders.pending_short.accept.description: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.pick.description: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.pack.description: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.ship.description: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending_short.cancel.description: Short status chip on an online order (list and detail): this action is saved on the till but the online shop has not been told yet. Sits in a chip that does not wrap, so keep it short.

channel_orders.pending.hint.description: Muted line under the chips of actions waiting to be sent.

channel_orders.refused_short.description: Short chip in the Online orders list: the online shop refused an action on this order and the refusal has not been dismissed. Sits in a chip that does not wrap.

channel_orders.ship.carrier.description: Field label in the ship form: the delivery company, typed by staff (for example a postal service).

channel_orders.ship.tracking_number.description: Field label in the ship form: the carrier's parcel tracking number. May be left empty.

channel_orders.ship.tracking_url.description: Field label in the ship form: a web link (https://...) where the customer can follow the parcel. May be left empty.

channel_orders.ship.submit.description: Confirm button of the ship form.

channel_orders.queued.tracking_number.description: Label next to the tracking number of a queued ship action (read-only, no 'optional').

channel_orders.queued.tracking_url.description: Label next to the tracking link of a queued ship action (read-only, shown as text, no 'optional').

channel_orders.cancel.reason.description: Field label in the cancel form: why the order is cancelled.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.choose.description: First, empty option of the cancel reason list. The reason is sent to the online shop, so there is no default.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.customer_re.description: Cancel reason: the customer asked for it.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.out_of_stoc.description: Cancel reason: the shop cannot supply the items.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.fraud.description: Cancel reason: the order looks fraudulent.

channel_orders.cancel.reason.other.description: Cancel reason: none of the others applies.

channel_orders.cancel.restock.description: Checkbox in the cancel form (ticked by default): the order's items go back into this till's stock when the online shop confirms the cancel.

channel_orders.cancel.warning.description: Warning at the top of the cancel form.

channel_orders.cancel.submit.description: Confirm button of the cancel form (destructive).

channel_orders.cancel.keep.description: Button in the cancel form that closes it without cancelling. Deliberately not 'Cancel', which staff would misread.

channel_orders.error.carrier_required.description: Field error in the ship form: the carrier is empty.

channel_orders.error.carrier_invalid.description: Field error in the ship form: the carrier is too long or has control characters.

channel_orders.error.tracking_number_inv.description: Field error in the ship form: the tracking number has characters the online shops do not take. The characters - . _ / are literal.

channel_orders.error.tracking_url_invali.description: Field error in the ship form: the tracking link is not an https:// web address. https:// is literal.

channel_orders.error.reason_invalid.description: Field error in the cancel form: no reason chosen.

channel_orders.error.action_not_allowed.description: Error above the buttons when the tapped step is no longer possible for the order.

channel_orders.error.save_failed.description: Error above the buttons when saving an action on the till failed.

channel_orders.error.actions_not_here.description: Error when an action is attempted on a till that is not the main till, or is not linked to the cloud.

channel_orders.refused.title.description: Start of the notice about a refused action; followed by the action's name and the reason.

channel_orders.refused.invalid_transitio.description: Refusal reason: picking, packing or shipping before accepting.

channel_orders.refused.order_cancelled.description: Refusal reason: the order is already cancelled.

channel_orders.refused.order_refunded.description: Refusal reason: the order is already refunded.

channel_orders.refused.already_shipped.description: Refusal reason: cancel or ship after the order shipped.

channel_orders.refused.stale.description: Refusal reason: the action was queued for more than 30 days.

channel_orders.refused.plan_required.description: Refusal reason: the subscription plan does not cover this sales channel.

channel_orders.refused.connection_revoke.description: Refusal reason: the channel connection was removed. my.universaltill.com is a web address; keep it.

channel_orders.refused.order_changed.description: Refusal reason: the order's content changed before the cancel reached the shop.

channel_orders.refused.unknown_order.description: Refusal reason: the order id is unknown to the cloud.

channel_orders.refused.invalid_action.description: Refusal reason: the shipment or cancel details broke a rule.

channel_orders.refused.generic.description: Refusal reason for any reason code this till does not know.

channel_orders.note.writeback_skipped.description: Notice after a ship or cancel the cloud accepted but the channel cannot receive: staff must repeat it in the channel's own admin.

channel_orders.dismiss.description: Button that removes a notice about an action's outcome.

channel_orders.blocked.main_till_require.description: Banner: the cloud refused because this till is not the main till.

channel_orders.blocked.store_mismatch.description: Banner: the cloud refused because the till is linked to another shop.

channel_orders.blocked.device_credential.description: Banner: the till has no credential of its own and must be paired again.

channel_orders.blocked.generic.description: Banner for any other refusal that blocks the till's actions.

channel_orders.blocked.count.description: Label in front of the number of actions the cloud refused to take from this till.

channel_orders.blocked.dismiss_all.description: Button that removes all the actions the cloud refused to take, on every order.

channel_orders.detail.offline_note.description: Muted note under the action buttons: they work offline.

channel_orders.detail.no_actions_note.description: Muted note shown instead of the action buttons on an additional till, for staff without stock rights, or on a till not linked to the cloud.

reports.tab.online_channels.description: Reports tab button: totals of orders from the shop's web shop and marketplaces (sales channels), not till sales. Different from the 'Payments & channels' tab, which is about payment methods at the till.

reports.online_channels.title.description: Heading of the Online channels report: totals of web-shop and marketplace orders for the selected period.

reports.online_channels.notice.description: Line under the Online channels heading: these orders are not till sales and are not in the till's key figures, the cash drawer, the day-end (Z) report or the fiscal journal. Describe, do not claim compliance.

reports.online_channels.link.description: Link from the Online channels report to the Online orders list page.

reports.online_channels.col.currency.description: Column heading: the ISO currency code of the orders in that row (amounts are never added across currencies).

reports.online_channels.col.orders.description: Column heading: number of online orders counted in that row.

reports.online_channels.col.gross.description: Column heading: sum of the order totals as the channel reported them (including shipping and any tax the channel added). Not 'gross of tax' in the accounting sense; avoid a word that means 'including VAT'.

reports.online_channels.col.refunds.description: Column heading: amount refunded so far on those orders by the channel.

reports.online_channels.col.net.description: Column heading: order totals minus refunds. Means 'after refunds', not 'excluding tax'.

reports.online_channels.currency_total.description: Row label: total of all channels for one currency (shown only when two or more channels use that currency).

reports.online_channels.refunds_note.description: Note under the Online channels table: refunds are counted in the period the order was placed, not the day the refund happened.

reports.online_channels.cancelled_unpaid.description: Note under the Online channels table: how many orders in the period were cancelled before the customer paid and are therefore left out of all figures ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

reports.online_channels.empty.description: Online channels report when no online order is left to count in the selected period.

desktop.startup_failed.title.description: Heading of the window the desktop app shows when the till program stopped right after it was opened.

desktop.startup_failed.body.description: Paragraph under the heading explaining that the till program stopped right after opening.

desktop.startup_failed.step_retry.description: First step in the numbered list: close the window and open the app again.

desktop.startup_failed.step_reinstall.description: Second step in the numbered list: reinstall from the latest installer; saved data is kept. Keep the product name unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.logs.description: Sentence introducing the data folder path, asking the user to send the two log files from it to support. File names desktop.log and till.log stay unchanged.

desktop.startup_failed.detail.description: Label before the technical reason (for example an exit status) shown in small text for support.

settings.backup.restore_refused.description: Notice in Settings → Backups after the till refused, at restart, a staged restore whose file was not a usable till database. Shown until the next restore is staged.

settings.backup.save_failed_space.description: Backups list message when the copy could not be saved because the destination is full.

settings.backup.save_failed_permission.description: Backups list message when the till may not write to the destination folder.

settings.backup.save_failed_unreachable.description: Backups list message when the destination folder (for example a USB drive) cannot be reached.

settings.backup.save_failed_picker_unava.description: Backups list message on Android when the app's file picker bridge is missing, so the backup could not be saved. Says what to do instead.

settings.backup.picker_saved.description: Backups list message after the Android file picker saved the backup copy.

settings.backup.picker_cancelled.description: Backups list message when the operator closed the Android file picker without choosing a place.

settings.backup.picker_failed.description: Backups list message when writing the backup to the place chosen in the Android file picker failed.

settings.backup.picker_no_space.description: Backups list message when the place chosen in the Android file picker is full.

settings.backup.safety_failed.description: Error in Settings → Backups when the till could not snapshot the current data before a restore, so the restore was not staged.

settings.backup.delete.description: Button on a row of the backups list that deletes that backup file.

settings.backup.delete_confirm.description: Question asked before a backup file is deleted from the backups list.

settings.backup.delete_failed.description: Error when deleting a backup file failed.

settings.backup.delete_invalid.description: Error when the name sent to delete is not a backup file.

settings.backup.delete_missing.description: Error when the backup to delete is already gone.

settings.backup.delete_newest.description: Error when someone tries to delete the newest backup, which is always kept.

settings.backup.deleted.description: Confirmation shown after a backup file was deleted.

settings.backup.newest_kept.description: Label on the newest backup row, which has no Delete button because it is always kept.

settings.backup.retention_days.description: Label of the number field: how many days of backups the till keeps.

settings.backup.retention_failed.description: Error when the backup days setting could not be saved.

settings.backup.retention_hint.description: Help under the backup days field: older backups are deleted automatically when the next one is made; the newest is always kept.

settings.backup.retention_invalid.description: Error for a backup days value that is not a whole number in range.
placeholders: the largest allowed number of days

settings.backup.retention_save.description: Button that saves the backup days setting.

settings.backup.retention_saved.description: Confirmation shown after the backup days setting was saved.

settings.backup.upload.title.description: Heading of the part of Settings → Backups where a manager uploads a backup file (for example from a USB stick) to restore it.

settings.backup.upload.help.description: Help line under 'Restore from a file'. The file name pattern unitill-pos-….db stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.label.description: Label of the file picker for the backup file to restore.

settings.backup.upload.action.description: Button that uploads the chosen backup file so the till can check it. Nothing is restored yet.

settings.backup.upload.checking.description: Shown while the backup file uploads and is checked (can take a while for a large file).

settings.backup.upload.shop.description: Line in the checked-backup summary naming the shop the backup belongs to.
placeholders: the shop name stored in the backup

settings.backup.upload.sales.description: Line in the checked-backup summary: how many sales the backup holds.
placeholders: the number of sales

settings.backup.upload.newest_sale.description: Line in the checked-backup summary: the date and time of the newest sale in the backup, the cut-off of what a restore brings back.
placeholders: the date and time of the newest sale

settings.backup.upload.no_sales.description: Line in the checked-backup summary when the backup holds no sales.

settings.backup.upload.replaces.description: Warning above the Restore button for an uploaded backup.

settings.backup.upload.live_sales.description: Extra warning above the Restore button when this till has already rung up sales.

settings.backup.upload.restore.description: Button that restores the uploaded, checked backup (asks for the manager PIN next).

settings.backup.upload.error.not_backup.description: Error when the uploaded file is not a till database or fails the integrity check. Product name and file pattern stay unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.error.newer.description: Error when the uploaded backup's database schema is newer than this till's build.

settings.backup.upload.error.other_shop.description: Error when the uploaded backup names a different my. shop than the one this till is paired with.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_space.description: Error when the disk is already below the low-disk floor, so no upload is accepted.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_file.description: Error when the form was sent without a file.

settings.backup.upload.error.failed.description: Generic error when checking an uploaded backup failed for a reason on the till's side.

import.welcome.restore.body.description: Line under the ways to start on the welcome page after setup, for a new device replacing a broken till.

import.welcome.restore.action.description: Button on the welcome page that opens Settings → Backups → Restore from a file.

settings.backup.upload.ready.description: Shown after an uploaded backup passed every check; the file name follows on the same line. Product name stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.error.too_old.description: Error when the uploaded backup comes from a version before the database schema reset, which this build cannot open.

settings.backup.upload.error.too_large.description: Error when the uploaded file is over the size cap (a fixed maximum, or less when the disk is fuller).
placeholders: the largest file size allowed, for example 1.5 GB

status.backup_copy.label.description: Status-bar chip for managers: no backup was downloaded or saved off this till in the last 7 days. Links to Settings → Backups.

status.backup_copy.hint.description: Tooltip of the no-backup-copied chip: why and how to copy a backup off the till.

tills.sales_mirror.title.description: Heading of the Tills page card for the read-only copy of the shop's sales kept on every additional till (ut-docs#5074).

tills.sales_mirror.help.description: Explanation under the sales-copy card heading on the Tills page.

tills.sales_mirror.status_on.description: State of the shop-wide sales copy on the main till: switched on.

tills.sales_mirror.status_off.description: State of the shop-wide sales copy on the main till: switched off (the default).

tills.sales_mirror.window.description: How long each additional till keeps copied sales.
placeholders: number of days

tills.sales_mirror.till_waiting.description: Line per additional till on the main till: that till has not fetched its copy yet.
placeholders: till name

tills.sales_mirror.till_catching_up.description: Line per additional till on the main till: how many changes its copy is behind.
placeholders: till name
number of changes

tills.sales_mirror.till_up_to_date.description: Line per additional till on the main till: its copy is current.
placeholders: till name

tills.sales_mirror.turn_on.description: Button on the main till that switches the shop's sales copy on.

tills.sales_mirror.turn_off.description: Button on the main till that switches the shop's sales copy off (copies are kept).

tills.sales_mirror.copy_behind.description: On an additional till: how many changes its copy is behind the main till.
placeholders: number of changes

tills.sales_mirror.copy_summary.description: On an additional till: how many sales its copy holds and the oldest day (YYYY-MM-DD).
placeholders: number of copied sales
oldest copied day

tills.sales_mirror.copy_empty.description: On an additional till with the copy on: nothing copied yet.

tills.sales_mirror.state.up_to_date.description: State of this additional till's copy: current.

tills.sales_mirror.state.off.description: State of this additional till's copy: the shop has the copy switched off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.off_here.description: State of this additional till's copy: this till's own switch is off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.paused_low_disk.description: State of this additional till's copy: paused because the disk is nearly full (only the last 31 days are kept).

tills.sales_mirror.state.paused_budget.description: State of this additional till's copy: paused at its disk budget.

tills.sales_mirror.state.needs_update.description: State of this additional till's copy: the main till runs a newer copy format; update this till.

tills.sales_mirror.state.needs_tls.description: State of this additional till's copy: it has no secure (pinned TLS) link to the main till yet.

tills.sales_mirror.state.main_off.description: State of this additional till's copy: the main till has the copy switched off.

tills.sales_mirror.state.satellite.description: State on a satellite till: satellites keep no copy of the shop's sales.

tills.sales_mirror.state.catching_up.description: State of this additional till's copy: it is fetching changes or re-syncing; the count of changes to go follows.

tills.promote_adopted.description: Promote result on a till that kept a copy of the shop's sales: how many copied sales became its own record.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_failed.description: Promote result: some copied sales could not be added to this till's record (a receipt number or reference it refuses); they stay in the copy.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_voided.description: Promote result: sales this till held as completed that the copy knew were voided, now voided here too.
placeholders: number of sales

tills.promote_adopt_resumes.description: Promote result: adopting the copy stopped (an error); nothing is lost and it resumes on its own.

tills.promote_outside_z.description: Promote warning: sales from before the previous main till's last close that never reached it in time, so they may be in no Z report.
placeholders: number of sales

sync.quarantine_reason.single_purpose_vo.description: Reason column on /sync-quarantine: a journaled top-up of a single-purpose voucher (VAT fixed at issue) from an additional till was refused, so the entry is quarantined.

categories.item_count_plural.description: Count of active catalog items in a category, shown in the category list and the menu designer ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

products.category_button_count_plural.description: Count of quick buttons on the sale screen for a category, shown in the category tile overflow and the menu designer ({count} is the number; plural forms per language).

inventory.empty.description: Empty row of the Inventory stock table, shown only when the shop has no active stock-tracked items at all (every tracked item is listed, even at 0). Says what to do next. 'Catalog' is the menu section and 'Not stock-tracked' is the checkbox label on an item there; use the same wording as those labels.

plugins.install.error.pair_required.description: Error shown when installing a paid plugin from a till that is not paired with its shop: tells the owner to pair the till first. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.pair_again.description: Error shown when the marketplace rejects this till's credential (expired, replaced or mismatched): tells the owner to pair the till with the shop again. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.till_removed.description: Error shown when the shop has removed, replaced or moved this till so it can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to pair it with the shop again. 'Pair with a shop' is the section label under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.till_replaced.description: Error shown when another till in the shop replaced this one so it can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to install plugins on the till that replaced it.

plugins.install.error.till_moved.description: Error shown when this till was moved to another shop so its old shop connection can no longer download plugins: tells the owner to connect it to its new shop under Settings > Till registration.

plugins.install.error.register_new.description: Error shown when the cloud rejects this till's credential and its store has no owner yet: tells the owner to reconnect the till under Settings > Till registration > Reconnect this till.

plugins.install.error.service_unavailabl.description: Error shown when the marketplace refuses plugin downloads for this shop because its country is not served.

plugins.install.error.unreachable.description: Error on a Plugin Store listing page, and on the store tile after a failed install, when the till could not connect to the plugin marketplace (offline, DNS or timeout).

plugins.install.error.download_failed.description: Error on a Plugin Store listing page when pressing Download failed for a reason with no more specific message; 'Download' is the button label on that page.

agent.action.catalog_item_update.description: Title of the confirm card when the AI assistant proposes changing existing items' name, price, category or barcode.

agent.field.name.description: Row label on the AI confirm card for an item's name change.

agent.field.category.description: Row label on the AI confirm card for an item's category change.

agent.items.no_photo.description: Screen-reader label for the empty thumbnail of an item that has no photo in the AI assistant's item list.

agent.items.open_catalog.description: Button under the AI assistant's item list that opens the catalog showing the same items.

catalog.missing.barcode.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a barcode (opened from an AI assistant answer).

catalog.missing.image.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a photo.

catalog.missing.price.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items with no price (zero).

catalog.missing.category.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items without a category.

catalog.missing.several.description: Banner on the catalog when it is filtered to items missing any of barcode, photo, price or category.

catalog.missing.clear.description: Link in the filter banner that returns to the full catalog list.

settings.update.fleet_follow_label.description: Label of the dropdown in Settings → Software update (main till only) that chooses when additional tills install the main till's version.

settings.update.fleet_follow_next_idle.description: Option in the 'When additional tills update' dropdown (the default): an additional till installs the main till's version as soon as it has no open sale.

settings.update.fleet_follow_nightly.description: Option in the 'When additional tills update' dropdown: an additional till installs the main till's version only at the main till's nightly update time.

settings.update.fleet_follow_hint.description: Muted line under the 'When additional tills update' dropdown: additional tills always install this (main) till's version and never run ahead of it.

settings.update.follows_main_nightly_win.description: Second muted line on an additional till's Settings → Software update when the shop updates additional tills at the nightly time: the window in which THIS till starts its install (main till's update time plus this till's own offset, 30 minutes long). Follows the line saying this till follows the main till's version.
placeholders: start of this till's nightly install window, HH:MM, e.g. 03:07
end of that window, HH:MM, e.g. 03:37

settings.update.follows_main_failed_nigh.description: Muted line on an additional till's Settings → Software update when its last automatic install of the main till's version failed and the shop updates additional tills at the nightly time, so it retries the next night.
placeholders: the main till's version, e.g. v1.4.0
start of this till's nightly install window, HH:MM
end of that window, HH:MM

page.title.move_till.description: Browser tab title of the page where a manager approves or declines moving this till into another shop.

settings.move.title.description: Heading of the page where a manager or admin approves or declines moving this till (with its history) into another shop's cloud account.

settings.move.from.description: Label before the name of the shop this till belongs to now, on the move approval page.

settings.move.into.description: Label before the name of the shop the till would move into, on the move approval page.

settings.move.expires.description: Label before the date and time after which the move request expires and nothing moves.

settings.move.warning.description: Plain warning on the move approval page: what approving does (all history goes to the other account) and an anti-scam line. No compliance claims.

settings.move.who.description: Line under the warning: who decides (manager/admin PIN) and that selling continues meanwhile.

settings.move.type_name.description: Label of the text field where the approver types the target shop's name (shown right after the label) before Approve works.

settings.move.approve.description: Primary button: approve moving this till into the other shop (asks for a PIN next).

settings.move.decline.description: Secondary button: decline the move (asks for a PIN next). Nothing moves.

settings.move.offline.description: Shown when the cloud is out of reach: the decision cannot be sent; nothing is queued.

settings.move.gone.description: Shown on the move page when the move is unknown or already ended.

settings.move.name_mismatch.description: Error when the typed target shop name does not match; nothing was sent and no PIN was asked.

settings.move.summary_approve.description: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (approve a move).

settings.move.summary_decline.description: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (decline a move).

placeholders: the name of the shop the till moved into

settings.move.declined.description: After a declined move (or one already declined).

settings.move.locked.description: After 3 wrong PINs on one move: it is declined automatically.

settings.move.result_expired.description: The cloud says the move expired.

settings.move.result_cancelled.description: The target shop's owner cancelled the move on my.

settings.move.result_done.description: The cloud says the move already happened.

settings.move.result_failed.description: The cloud refused the move after approval (state changed) or moves are switched off.

settings.move.result_quarantined.description: The till's approval key was reported recently and is in its waiting period.
placeholders: the date and time from which the till can approve

settings.move.result_key.description: Approval key conflict, missing or unusable on the till.

settings.move.result_invalid.description: Signature or credential refused by the cloud.

settings.move.result_error.description: Any other failure sending the decision.

settings.move.notice_pending.description: Banner for managers/admins when a move waits for this till's approval.
placeholders: the name of the shop asking to take the till
the date and time the request expires

settings.move.notice_review.description: Link in the move banner (and after pairing) that opens the approval page.

settings.move.notice_cancelled.description: Banner after the target owner cancelled a pending move.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_expired.description: Banner after a pending move expired.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_locked.description: Banner after a move was declined automatically for wrong PINs.
placeholders: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.pending_msg.description: After Pair: the cloud recorded the move; it waits for approval on this till.

settings.move.confirm_title.description: Heading of the confirmation after pressing Pair on a till that belongs to a shop, where pairing asks to move it.

settings.move.confirm_body.description: Body of that confirmation. Keep both placeholders; the till wraps each in bidi isolates.
placeholders: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set
the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted (keep as is)

settings.move.confirm_btn.description: Primary button of that confirmation: send the code and ask for the move.

settings.move.source_lost.description: Pair refused on the till: its old shop credential is dead and it has history; nothing changed.

settings.move.refused.description: Generic refusal of a move request (wrong code, server error...).

settings.move.refused_needs_owner.description: Move refused: the code was made by a member, not the owner.

settings.move.refused_other_owner.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a different owner.

settings.move.refused_shop_has_tills.description: Move refused: the till's current shop has other tills.

settings.move.refused_region.description: Move refused (at pairing or at approval): the two shops are in different data regions. Terminal.

settings.move.refused_fiscal_device.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a fiscal device (e.g. TSE). No compliance claims.

settings.move.refused_paid_licence.description: Move refused: the till's shop has a paid/granted plan.

settings.move.refused_target_unavailable.description: Move refused: the target shop already has a main till, is merging, or is unavailable.

settings.move.refused_source_unavailable.description: Move refused: the till's current shop is unavailable (deleted or merging).

settings.move.refused_pending.description: Move refused: another move is already pending for this till.

settings.move.refused_declined_recently.description: Move refused: a recent decline blocks this requester for a day.

promotions.col.dates.description: Column header on the Promotions list: the promotion's start and end dates, shown as two stacked lines in one column. An open side shows a dash.

promotions.deactivate_confirm.description: Confirmation shown before a promotion is deactivated from its edit dialog: says it stops working at checkout and can be reactivated.

promotions.edit_title.description: Title of the Promotions record dialog when an existing promotion is opened for editing.

promotions.empty.description: Empty state on the Promotions page when no promotion exists yet; points at the + button next to the search field.

promotions.search_placeholder.description: Label and placeholder of the search field above the Promotions list (filters rows by code, description or customer).

kitchenstations.search_placeholder.description: Label and placeholder of the search field above the Kitchen stations list (filters rows by name, destination or printer address).

kitchenstations.joined.hint.description: Page-level note shown under the Kitchen stations header on a joined till, explaining why New is disabled.

kitchenstations.joined.dialog_hint.description: Note at the top of the station dialog on a joined till, explaining the read-only Name and Destination.

kitchenstations.edit.description: Title of the Kitchen stations record dialog when an existing station is opened for editing.

kitchenstations.empty.description: Empty state on the Kitchen stations page when no station exists yet; points at the + button and says where tickets go meanwhile.

kitchenstations.deactivate_confirm.description: Confirmation shown before a station is deactivated from its dialog; says orders stop and station-only routes fall back to the default kitchen printer.

kitchenstations.discover.used.description: Confirmation shown under Find printers after the operator taps Use this address on a discovered printer; the address field is filled but not yet saved.

notices.title.description: Heading of the Notices inbox page, listing messages from Universal Till and from partners.

notices.nav.description: Label of the bell in the left rail (and the Notices row of the phone menu) that opens the Notices inbox.

notices.nav.unread.description: Accessible name of the bell when something is unread: the label plus how many notices are unread.
placeholders: how many notices are unread

notices.drawer.open_unread.description: Accessible name of the phone top bar menu button while notices are unread: the menu label plus how many are unread.
placeholders: how many notices are unread

notices.tab.unread.description: Inbox tab showing only notices not yet opened or dismissed.

notices.tab.all.description: Inbox tab showing every notice currently held, read or not.

notices.sev.info.description: Severity word on a notice: plain information, shown in the inbox only.

notices.sev.important.description: Severity word on a notice that also pops up once on the sale screen.

notices.sev.critical.description: Severity word on a notice from Universal Till that stays as a strip on every screen until a manager acknowledges it.

notices.sender.platform.description: Sender shown on a notice sent by Universal Till itself. A brand name: never translate it.

notices.sender.partner.description: Sender line on a notice sent by a partner of the shop; the partner name comes from the server.
placeholders: the partner's name

notices.sender.sr.description: Screen-reader-only word placed before the sender of a notice.

notices.unread.sr.description: Screen-reader-only word placed before the title of an unread notice.

notices.expires.description: Expiry line of a notice in the inbox; the date follows in the shop's date format.
placeholders: the date the notice stops showing

notices.open.description: Button or link that opens a notice in full, or follows the action link it carries.

notices.dismiss.description: Button that hides a notice from the Unread tab; it stays in All until it expires.

notices.dismiss.aria.description: Accessible name of the close button on a pop-up notice, naming the notice.
placeholders: the notice title

notices.empty.title.description: Heading of the empty Notices inbox.

notices.empty.body.description: Sentence under the empty-inbox heading: says what appears here and that selling is not affected.

notices.critical.ack.description: Button on a critical notice that a manager or admin presses to say they have seen it; it removes the strip.

notices.critical.cashier.description: Second line of the critical strip for a cashier, who cannot acknowledge it: a manager has been told and selling continues.

page.title.notices.description: Browser tab title of the Notices inbox page.

permissions.action.notices.view.description: Name of the permission that lets a role see the Notices bell and inbox, and mark notices read or acknowledged.

permissions.action_desc.notices.view.description: One-line description of the Notices permission on the Permissions page.

settings.telemetry.help.description: Help text of the Plugin telemetry settings card: what the periodic report contains (active plugins, versions, shop and device IDs), that no sales or customer data is sent, and that it is off by default.

settings.notices.title.description: Heading of the Settings card that switches Notices on or off for this till.

settings.notices.help.description: Help text of the Notices settings card: what it shows, that a notice never blocks a sale, off by default, and that turning it off removes held notices.

settings.notices.enable.description: Checkbox label that switches Notices on for this till.

settings.notices.save.description: Save button of the Notices settings card.

settings.printer.voucher_slip.description: Checkbox label in Settings > Receipt printer: when ticked, every gift voucher sold or topped up in a sale also prints on its own separate slip after the receipt.

settings.printer.voucher_slip_hint.description: Help line under the separate-gift-voucher-slip checkbox in Settings > Receipt printer: when it prints, what is on the slip (a top-up's slip adds the amount added and the new balance), and that voided vouchers and top-ups taken back get none.

journal.reprint_no_slips.description: Button on a past sale's journal page, next to Print receipt: prints the receipt again but leaves out the separate gift voucher slips. Shown only when 'Print each gift voucher on its own slip' is on and the sale has a valid voucher.

page.title.name_shop.description: Browser/page title of the page that asks a manager for the shop and/or till name before opening manager pages.

name_shop.heading_both.description: Heading when both the shop name and this till's own name are missing.

name_shop.heading_shop.description: Heading when only the shop name is missing.

name_shop.heading_till.description: Heading when only this till's own name is missing.

name_shop.intro.description: Shown above one or both name fields; must read right whether one or two fields are asked for. Says selling is never blocked.

name_shop.till_name_help.description: Help line inside the till-name field's label, with an example name.

name_shop.save.description: Submit button on the name-your-shop page; saves the names and goes on to the page the manager opened.

name_shop.error.till_name_invalid.description: Inline refusal under the till-name field for a blank, too long, or control-character name.

subscription.banner.lapsed.fix_ios.description: iPhone/iPad app only, instead of subscription.banner.lapsed.fix: second line of the 'Paid features are paused' notice when the shop's subscription has ended. Says the till picks up an active subscription by itself and that Check now checks at once. Must not tell the reader to renew, pay or go anywhere to buy (App Store rules).

subscription.banner.lapsed.fix_via_main_.description: iPhone/iPad app only, instead of subscription.banner.lapsed.fix_via_main: the same notice on a till registered through its main till, so Check now is pressed on the main till. Must not tell the reader to renew, pay or go anywhere to buy (App Store rules).

subscription.check_result.still_lapsed_i.description: iPhone/iPad app only, instead of subscription.check_result.still_lapsed: one-line result of Check now when the cloud answered that the subscription is still not active. Must not mention paying or renewing (App Store rules).

tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refus.description: iPhone/iPad app only, instead of tills.join_error.unsent_day_closes_refused: join error on a joined till whose day closes cannot reach the cloud because the cloud refuses uploads (subscription not active). Names the one fix the app can offer (report retention on this till); must not tell the reader to renew.
placeholders: how many day closes are not in the cloud yet

designer.category.edit_image.description: Till Designer, expanded category row: label of the link that opens that category's dialog on Items → Categories, where its picture or icon is changed.

designer.category.edit_image_for.description: Till Designer: accessible name of the Change picture or icon link on a category row; starts with the visible label and names the category.
placeholders: category name

plugin.view.page_failed.description: Notice above a plugin's panel on a till screen (Reports, item dialog, end-of-day, Settings) when tapping Next/Previous under the panel's table fails or takes too long. The panel keeps showing the page the operator was already on, so the text must not say nothing is shown. 'Page' means a page of rows in that table, not a web page.

inventory.stocktake.start.description: Button in the Inventory page header (main till, manager): starts counting the stock of one location.

inventory.stocktake.choose_location.description: Inventory > Stock-take, shown only when the shop has two or more locations: label of the location picker.

inventory.stocktake.begin.description: Inventory > Stock-take, location picker: primary button that opens the count table for the chosen location.

inventory.stocktake.title.description: Inventory > Stock-take: heading of the count screen.
placeholders: name of the location being counted

inventory.stocktake.mode_chip.description: Inventory > Stock-take: small chip next to the heading saying the page is in count mode.

inventory.stocktake.col_counted.description: Inventory > Stock-take: column header of the box where the quantity found on the shelf is typed.

inventory.stocktake.col_in_stock.description: Inventory > Stock-take: column header of the quantity the till currently shows for the item at that location (also in the review table).

inventory.stocktake.col_difference.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: column header of counted minus in-stock, shown with a plus or minus sign.

inventory.stocktake.counted_n.description: Inventory > Stock-take: badge in the bottom bar with the number of lines that have a count typed in.
placeholders: number of lines with a count

inventory.stocktake.review.description: Inventory > Stock-take: bottom-bar button that opens the review of the counted lines.

inventory.stocktake.review_title.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: heading above the table of counted lines.

inventory.stocktake.back.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: secondary button that returns to the count table with every count kept.

inventory.stocktake.apply.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: primary button that saves all counted lines at once.

inventory.stocktake.applying.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: label of the Apply count button while the count is being saved.

inventory.stocktake.keep.description: Inventory > Stock-take: button on the discard or leave confirmation that returns to counting.

inventory.stocktake.discard.description: Inventory > Stock-take: button on the cancel confirmation that throws the typed counts away.

inventory.stocktake.discard_confirm.description: Inventory > Stock-take: inline question shown in the bottom bar when Cancel is pressed after counts were typed.

inventory.stocktake.leave_confirm.description: Inventory > Stock-take: inline question shown in the bottom bar when the operator taps a link to another page while counts are typed.

inventory.stocktake.leave.description: Inventory > Stock-take: button on the leave confirmation that goes to the other page and loses the counts.

inventory.stocktake.no_change.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: shown in the Difference column when the counted quantity equals the quantity in stock.

inventory.stocktake.note.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: label of the optional note saved with the count (up to 200 characters).

inventory.stocktake.blank_hint.description: Inventory > Stock-take: hint above the count table explaining that an empty box is not counted and 0 means none on the shelf.

inventory.stocktake.bad_number.description: Inventory > Stock-take: message under a Counted box holding something that is not a quantity.

inventory.stocktake.too_many.description: Inventory > Stock-take: message in the bottom bar when more than 500 lines have a count; Review stays off.

inventory.stocktake.none_counted.description: Inventory > Stock-take: message in the bottom bar while no line has a count; Review stays off.

inventory.stocktake.fix_rows.description: Inventory > Stock-take: message in the bottom bar while a Counted box holds an invalid value; Review stays off.

inventory.stocktake.applied.description: Inventory: confirmation line shown above the refreshed stock table after a stock-take was applied.
placeholders: lines counted
lines whose stock changed
lines already matching the count

inventory.stocktake.empty.description: Inventory > Stock-take: shown instead of the table when the chosen location has no item that tracks stock.

inventory.stocktake.replica_hint.description: Inventory page on an additional (replica) till: replaces the Stock-take button, because counts must be made on the main till.

inventory.stocktake.error.invalid_lines.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: heading of the error box when the till refused the count because some lines are invalid.

inventory.stocktake.error.save_failed.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: error box when saving failed for a reason on the till or the connection to it.

inventory.stocktake.error.replica_use_ma.description: Inventory > Stock-take: error when a stock-take is sent from an additional (replica) till.

inventory.stocktake.error.location_inval.description: Inventory > Stock-take: error when the chosen location was switched off or removed.

inventory.stocktake.error.started_at_inv.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: error when the stock-take was started more than 48 hours ago, so its counts are too old to apply.

inventory.stocktake.error.note_invalid.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: error when the optional note is over 200 characters or has line breaks or control characters.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.not_count.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line that cannot be counted at this location.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.duplicate.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line that appears twice in the count.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.target_in.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line whose counted quantity is negative or not a number.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.target_to.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line whose counted quantity is over one million.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.too_many_.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line whose counted quantity has more than three decimals.

inventory.stocktake.error.code.whole_num.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: reason printed under a line for an item that is not sold by weight but has a fractional count.

inventory.stocktake.load_failed.description: Inventory > Stock-take: inline error beside the Stock-take button when the count table could not be loaded; the table of stock levels stays in place.

inventory.stocktake.error.forbidden.description: Inventory > Stock-take review: error box when the signed-in user lost the stock-management permission (for example after a PIN switch) and the count was refused.

status.cloud_auth.blocked.description: Status-bar chip on a till whose cloud registration the cloud refused for now because this till was in use recently: it can reconnect later and keeps selling.

status.cloud_auth.blocked_hint.description: Tooltip of the 'Cloud reconnect paused' chip for a manager: when the till can reconnect, that selling is unaffected, and that support can allow it sooner.
placeholders: date and time the till can reconnect

status.cloud_auth.blocked_hint_short.description: Tooltip of the 'Cloud reconnect paused' chip for a cashier: neutral, no details; a manager finds them in Settings.

settings.enrol.device_live.description: Result of 'Register now' when the cloud refuses to register a till that was in use in the last 72 hours: it can reconnect from the date given.
placeholders: date and time the till can reconnect

plugins.install.error.device_live.description: Error shown when a plugin install cannot start because the cloud refused to register this till for now (it was in use recently); the date is on Settings > Till registration.

settings.till_registration.blocked_until.description: Notice on Settings > Till registration while the cloud refuses to register this till: when it can reconnect and that selling is unaffected.
placeholders: date and time the till can reconnect

settings.till_registration.blocked_soon.description: Notice on Settings > Till registration while the cloud refuses to register this till and no date is known.

settings.till_registration.blocked_help.description: Second paragraph of the registration notice: how to reconnect sooner, by asking support, with the till's ID and key fingerprint shown below it.

settings.till_registration.fingerprint.description: Label of this till's approval key fingerprint (32 characters in groups of four) on Settings > Till registration; support asks for it.

settings.till_registration.fingerprint_u.description: Shown instead of the key fingerprint when this till's key cannot be read.

elevation.summary.enrol_reconnect.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt for Reconnect this till under Settings > Till registration.

elevation.summary.enrol_new_shop.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt for Register as a new shop under Settings > Till registration.

status.cloud_auth.locked_out.description: Status-bar chip text for a registered till of an ownerless shop whose cloud sign-in was refused three times; short, one line.

status.cloud_auth.locked_out_hint.description: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager when the cloud refuses this till's sign-in on an ownerless shop.

status.cloud_auth.key_refused_hint.description: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager after the cloud refused this till's key proof.

status.cloud_auth.in_use_elsewhere_hint.description: Tooltip of the status-bar chip for a manager when the till's identity is live on another machine (a copied data folder) and automatic retries stopped.

settings.till_registration.lockout_notic.description: Standing notice on Settings > Till registration when the cloud refuses this till's sign-in on an ownerless shop.

settings.till_registration.lockout_help.description: Help line under the lock-out notice: which of the two actions to try first.

settings.till_registration.reconnect_btn.description: Button: re-register this till in its own shop, proving its approval key.

settings.till_registration.reconnecting.description: Shown next to the Reconnect button while the request runs.

settings.till_registration.reconnect_ok.description: Result after a successful Reconnect this till.

settings.till_registration.key_refused.description: Result when the cloud refuses this till's key proof, for a registered till locked out of its shop; support reads the device ID and fingerprint shown below this text; ends by offering Register as a new shop.

settings.till_registration.store_not_reu.description: Result of Reconnect when the shop was claimed by an owner or removed.

settings.till_registration.reconnect_una.description: Result when Reconnect or Register as a new shop is refused because the till is a replica or has an environment-pinned identity.

settings.till_registration.reconnect_fai.description: Result of Reconnect or Register as a new shop when the cloud could not be reached (network failure).

settings.till_registration.reconnect_ser.description: Result of Reconnect or Register as a new shop when the cloud answered with an error (server error or an unexpected refusal).

settings.till_registration.reconnect_oth.description: Result of Reconnect when the cloud's answer named a different shop than the till's own; nothing was saved. Support reads the device ID and fingerprint shown below.

settings.till_registration.reconnect_not.description: Result when Reconnect or Register as a new shop is refused because the till is not locked out of an ownerless shop (healthy, not registered, or the shop has an owner).

settings.till_registration.key_refused_u.description: Settings notice on a till that is not registered when the cloud refused its key proof; support reads the device ID and fingerprint shown below. No new-shop option applies here.

settings.till_registration.in_use_elsewh.description: Settings notice on a not-registered till whose identity is in use on two machines (copied data folder): only one can connect; says what to do.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_btn.description: Quiet secondary button: leave the old shop and register this till as a new one (opens a confirmation).

settings.till_registration.new_shop_hint.description: Line above the Register as a new shop button.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_titl.description: Title of the confirmation for Register as a new shop.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_conf.description: Body of the confirmation for Register as a new shop.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_yes.description: Confirm button of the Register as a new shop confirmation (danger styling).

settings.till_registration.new_shop_ok.description: Result after Register as a new shop succeeded.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_key_.description: Added to the new-shop success text when the plugin signing key fetch failed after registering.

settings.till_registration.new_shop_pend.description: Result when the identity wipe of Register as a new shop ran but the registration failed; the till is in the ordinary not-registered state.

settings.enrol.rate_limited.description: Result when the cloud rate-limits a registration or reconnect attempt (HTTP 429).

settings.enrol.update_needed.description: Result when the cloud asks for a key proof this build cannot make.

settings.display.f11_kiosk_locked.description: Status message shown in the alert strip when a manager presses F11 in the desktop app while the window is locked in kiosk mode; F11 never leaves kiosk, so it points to the Exit to OS window button in Settings.

confirm.remove.description: Confirm button of the till's in-page confirmation dialog when the action removes something (a barcode, a tile from the quick buttons, a modifier group from an item, an option value, sample data, a catalog item). Verb, imperative.

confirm.delete.description: Confirm button of the till's in-page confirmation dialog when the action deletes something for good (a modifier group, unassigned groups, an option set).

confirm.keep_order.description: Cancel button of the confirmation dialog shown before cancelling an open/parked order: leaves the order as it is. Pairs with 'Cancel order'.

vouchers.print_slip.browser_hint.description: Shown above Print voucher slip on a gift voucher's page (manager) when this till has no receipt printer: pressing the button opens just the slip in the browser's print dialog. A link to Settings > Receipt printer follows it. Keep it to two short sentences.

vouchers.print_slip.no_printer_hint.description: Shown instead of the Print voucher slip button on a gift voucher's page, on a kiosk till with no receipt printer set up and no print dialog. A link "Set up a receipt printer" follows.

vouchers.print_slip.no_printer.description: Inline refusal after Print voucher slip on a kiosk till with no receipt printer set up and no print dialog (only from a page opened before that state).

vouchers.print_slip.browser_opened.description: Inline status after Print voucher slip on a till with no receipt printer: the browser's print dialog opened with the slip. The till can't tell whether it was printed, saved or cancelled, so do not say 'printed' or 'sent'.

catalog.icon_match.head_last.description: Setting, never shown on screen. Type 1 if, in your language, the main noun of a compound word comes LAST (German: Milchkaffee is a coffee, Apfelsaft is a juice). Then the till can suggest the icon for compound item names. Otherwise type 0. Type only the digit, nothing else. Translators: leave 0 unless a maintainer has measured your language; only the ASCII digit 1 turns it on.

settings.printer.system_unavailable.description: Warning under the Connection choice in Settings > Receipt printer, shown only while Regular printer (system) is picked on a till whose own device has no operating-system printer set up (e.g. a kiosk built from the till image). Says Regular printer cannot print there and to choose Network (IP) or USB device instead; ends with a help link. Advisory: saving is still allowed.

catalog.builtin_icon.photo_active.description: Info notice in the item editor Item image tab, shown while the selected item has an uploaded photo: the photo shows, and a built-in image picked in the grid is saved underneath it; choosing No image first shows the built-in image instead.

catalog.builtin_icon.saved_fallback.description: Success notice after picking a built-in image on an item that has a photo: it was saved under the photo, the photo still shows, and how to show this image instead.

catalog.builtin_icon.generic_photo_kept.description: Info notice after picking the general (no-meaning) built-in image on an item that has a photo: nothing was saved, the photo still shows.

catalog.builtin_icon.fallback_hint.description: Tooltip and screen-reader hint appended to the built-in image tile that is saved underneath the item photo (its fallback); a short phrase, no full stop.

setup.tax_autoinstall.installing.description: Status chip shown on the page the setup wizard lands on, and in Settings, while the till installs its country's free tax plugin by itself (ADR-0172). Sales are never blocked.
placeholders: plugin name

setup.tax_autoinstall.installed.description: Status chip: the country's tax plugin finished installing automatically.
placeholders: plugin name

setup.tax_autoinstall.retrying.description: Status chip: the automatic tax plugin install has not worked yet and retries on its own; reassures that sales are not affected. A second line gives the reason.
placeholders: plugin name

setup.tax_autoinstall.error.offline.description: Second line under the retrying chip: the till is offline.

setup.tax_autoinstall.error.not_listed.description: Second line under the retrying chip: the plugin catalogue has no listing for the shop's country yet.

setup.tax_autoinstall.error.refused.description: Second line under the retrying chip: the downloaded plugin failed the till's own safety checks (signature, permissions or first-load test), so nothing was installed.

setup.tax_autoinstall.plugin_fallback_na.description: Generic plugin name used in the install status chip before the catalogue has named the plugin.

settings.plugins.auto_installed_for.description: Small note on a plugin card in Settings > Plugins: the till installed this plugin by itself for the shop's country.
placeholders: country name

settings.plugins.uninstall_tax_confirm.description: Confirm dialog text when uninstalling the automatically installed tax plugin: says what changes (each item's own tax rate applies to eat-in sales) and that it is not reinstalled automatically.
placeholders: plugin name

settings.plugins.dismiss_tax_pending_con.description: Confirm dialog text when removing the automatically queued tax plugin before it has installed: says the install stops, each item's own tax rate applies to eat-in sales, and it is not queued again automatically.
placeholders: plugin name

photoimport.open.description: Link on the Import page that opens the bulk photo import (adds photos to existing items from a CSV or ZIP).

photoimport.title.description: Heading of the Import page card that adds photos to existing items from a CSV or ZIP.

photoimport.help.description: Explanation at the top of the photo import card: existing items only, matched by SKU, preview saves nothing.

photoimport.csv.description: Label of the file field for the CSV that lists SKU and image path or address.

photoimport.zip.description: Label of the file field for an optional ZIP whose files are named after the item SKU.

photoimport.folder.description: Label of the text field for the folder on the till computer that holds the photos named in the CSV.

photoimport.folder_hint.description: Hint under the photos folder field: files outside the folder are refused; https addresses need internet.

photoimport.replace.description: Checkbox: also replace photos that items already have; off means only items without a photo get one.

photoimport.preview.description: Button that checks the photo import and shows what would happen without saving.

photoimport.import.description: Button that saves the photos shown in the preview.

photoimport.failed_csv.description: Link that downloads a CSV listing the rows the photo import could not handle, with the reason.

photoimport.truncated.description: Note under the result table when the list is cut off after a number of rows.
placeholders: the number of rows shown

photoimport.summary.preview.description: Summary line of the photo import preview.
placeholders: the number of photos that would be saved

photoimport.summary.done.description: Summary line after a photo import finished.
placeholders: the number of photos saved

photoimport.col.line.description: Table column: the line number in the CSV file.

photoimport.col.result.description: Table column: what happened to that row.

photoimport.error.main_till_only.description: Message on a joined till: photo import must be run on the main till.

photoimport.error.no_input.description: Error: neither a CSV nor a ZIP was chosen.

photoimport.error.bad_csv.description: Error: the photo import CSV is unreadable.

photoimport.error.no_sku_column.description: Error: the photo import CSV has no sku column.

photoimport.error.too_large.description: Error: the upload or number of rows exceeds the limit.

photoimport.error.bad_zip.description: Error: the uploaded ZIP is unreadable or has too many files.

photoimport.error.folder.description: Error: the folder typed in is not a full path, does not exist or is not a folder; tells the user to type the full path.

photoimport.error.busy.description: Error: another photo import is in progress.

photoimport.error.interrupted.description: Error: the run was interrupted; running again skips what is done.

photoimport.status.add.description: Row result: the item has no photo and gets one.

photoimport.status.replace.description: Row result: the item's photo is replaced.

photoimport.status.skipped_has_photo.description: Row result: item already has a photo and replacing is off.

photoimport.status.unknown_sku.description: Row result: no item has this SKU.

photoimport.status.ambiguous_sku.description: Row result: refused because the SKU is not unique.

photoimport.status.duplicate_sku.description: Row result: refused because the file lists this SKU more than once.

photoimport.status.variant_sku.description: Row result: refused because only items are supported, not variants.

photoimport.status.no_source.description: Row result: nothing to read the photo from.

photoimport.status.outside_folder.description: Row result: refused because the path leaves the chosen folder.

photoimport.status.not_found.description: Row result: the file does not exist.

photoimport.status.not_regular.description: Row result: the path is a folder or special file.

photoimport.status.too_big.description: Row result: the file is larger than the size limit.

photoimport.status.not_image.description: Row result: the file could not be read as an image.

photoimport.status.image_too_large.description: Row result: the image dimensions are too large.

photoimport.status.fetch_failed.description: Row result: the web address could not be downloaded.

photoimport.status.blocked_url.description: Row result: only public https addresses are allowed.

photoimport.status.store_failed.description: Row result: saving failed on this computer.

photoimport.status.total_limit.description: Row result: the run's total size limit was reached; run again.

page.title.my_display.description: Browser tab and page heading of the My display page, where an operator picks their own theme and sale screen layout.

settings.my_display.nav.description: Label of the session menu link to the My display page. Sits in a narrow top bar on phones, so keep it short.

settings.my_display.intro.description: Intro paragraph on the My display page: a personal theme and layout apply to this operator only, on every till.

settings.my_display.use_till_default.description: First option of the theme and layout pickers on My display: picking it clears the operator's own choice. The brackets show what the till currently uses.
placeholders: name of the till's current theme or layout

settings.my_display.theme_unavailable.description: Note under the theme picker on My display when the operator's saved theme has since been uninstalled.
placeholders: key of the operator's saved theme

settings.my_display.replica_notice.description: Notice on My display on an additional till: the pickers are switched off because the choice is made on the main till.

settings.my_display.no_operator.description: Notice on My display when nobody is signed in, so there is no operator to save a choice for.

settings.my_display.error.replica_use_pr.description: Error shown after Save on My display when an additional till refuses the change.

settings.my_display.error.unknown_theme.description: Error shown after Save on My display when the chosen theme is not installed on this till.

settings.my_display.error.unknown_mode.description: Error shown after Save on My display when the chosen sale screen layout is not one of the offered layouts.

settings.my_display.error.invalid.description: Error shown after Save on My display when the submitted value is malformed or too long.

plugins.store.report_listing.description: Link on a plugin's page in the Plugin Store. Opens the marketplace's report page in the browser so the person can report the listing (malware, deception, illegal content).

plugins.store.marketplace_terms.description: Link at the foot of the Plugin Store pages to the marketplace publisher terms on the website. It names a legal document, so keep it as the document's title.

plugins.store.content_guidelines.description: Link at the foot of the Plugin Store pages to the marketplace content guidelines on the website. It names a legal document, so keep it as the document's title.

registration.notice.title.description: Heading of the notice (setup wizard last screen, Settings Privacy card) that says what the till sends to Universal Till. Owner-approved checkin-notice-v2 text; legal text, translate faithfully.

registration.notice.body.description: First paragraph: what the till sends each start and on updates or plugin changes. checkin-notice-v2; legal text, translate faithfully, do not add or remove a data item.

registration.notice.fields.description: Second paragraph: what is never sent. checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.purpose.description: Third paragraph: why we use it and the legitimate-interest basis. checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.retention.description: Fourth paragraph: how long the data and the connecting address are kept. checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.availability.description: Fifth paragraph: selling never waits for the cloud. checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.stop_hint.description: Sixth paragraph: how to stop, the person rights, the right to complain to the data protection authority, and the support email. checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.controller.description: Last paragraph: who is responsible for the data (company name and number stay as written). checkin-notice-v2; legal text.

registration.notice.prompt.description: Status-bar link on a till set up before the notice existed; opens Settings, Privacy, where the notice is shown. Keep it short.

settings.privacy.title.description: Title of the Settings card (and its sidebar row) holding the usage-facts switch and the registration notice. Must match the card name quoted in registration.notice.stop_hint (checkin-notice-v2): Settings > Privacy.

settings.registration.title.description: Sub-heading, inside the Settings Privacy card, of the block showing whether this till is registered in the Universal Till cloud, with the notice and the Send usage facts switch.

settings.registration.status.registered.description: Status line in the Settings Privacy card when the till is registered. Always read with an icon, never colour alone.

settings.registration.status.not_registe.description: Status line in the Settings Privacy card when the till has not registered yet; it registers itself when online, nothing to do.

settings.registration.status.paused.description: Status line in the Settings Privacy card when the shop switched off Send usage facts: the till sends no registration or change reports.

settings.registration.last_checkin.description: Line in the Settings Privacy card: when the cloud last answered this till. The placeholder is a date and time already formatted for the language.
placeholders: the date and time of the last check-in, already formatted

settings.registration.no_checkin.description: Line in the Settings Privacy card when the cloud has not answered this till yet.

settings.registration.send_usage_facts.description: Visible label of the switch in Settings, Privacy that stops (off) or resumes (on) this shop sending usage facts to Universal Till. Must match the name quoted in registration.notice.stop_hint (checkin-notice-v2).

settings.registration.stop_help.description: Help under the Send usage facts switch while it is on: what switching it off does and does not do.

settings.registration.resume_help.description: Help under the Send usage facts switch while it is off.

elevation.summary.registration_stop.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier switches off Send usage facts in Settings, Privacy: names the action the approver is allowing.

elevation.summary.registration_resume.description: Sentence in the manager-PIN prompt shown when a cashier switches on Send usage facts in Settings, Privacy: names the action the approver is allowing.

settings.enrol.claim_store_code.description: Label before the claim code on Google Play and App Store builds, where the code is shown as plain text only (no link, no QR).

settings.enrol.claim_store_how.description: Instruction under the claim code on Google Play and App Store builds: claim on another device. Management wording only: no price, plan, buy or upgrade words, no link.

settings.enrol.claim_help_store.description: Help line above the Claim this store button on Google Play and App Store builds. Management wording only: no price, plan, buy or upgrade words.

settings.enrol.cloud_sync_off_store.description: Notice in Settings, Till registration on Google Play and App Store builds saying cloud sync is off. Status only: no plan, price or buy wording.

page.title.cloud_restore.description: Browser tab title of the page where a manager picks a cloud backup to restore onto this till.

backup.cloud.title.description: Heading of the Cloud backups card in Settings > Backups: the encrypted off-site copy of this till's data.

backup.cloud.state_waiting.description: Status line in the Cloud backups card before any off-site copy has been made.
