backup.cloud.queued.description: Message after pressing Copy to the cloud now: the copy was queued and runs without blocking sales.

backup.cloud.restore.description: Link in the Cloud backups card to the page that restores a cloud backup onto this till.

backup.cloud.privacy.description: Short privacy note in the Cloud backups card: what the off-site copy is, that the cloud holds a wrapped copy of the key, and who can approve a restore (legal wording).

backup.cloud.chip_failing.description: Status-bar chip for managers shown when the encrypted off-site copy has been failing for more than 2 days. Links to Settings > Backups.

backup.cloud.restore.title.description: Heading of the page where a manager restores a cloud backup onto this till.

backup.cloud.restore.intro.description: Introduction on the cloud restore page.

backup.cloud.restore.col_date.description: Column heading on the cloud restore page: when each cloud backup was made.

backup.cloud.restore.cutoff.description: Under each cloud backup in the restore list: the time the backup was made; later sales are not in it.
placeholders: date and time the backup was made

backup.cloud.restore.has_sales.description: Warning on the cloud restore page shown only when this till already holds sales.
placeholders: number of sales this till holds

backup.cloud.restore.pick.description: Button on the cloud restore page: restore this cloud backup; asks for the manager PIN next.

backup.cloud.restore.replaces.description: Note under the cloud backup list: a restore replaces everything on this till.

backup.cloud.restore.none.description: Empty state of the cloud restore page.

backup.cloud.restore.list_failed.description: Error on the cloud restore page when the list of backups could not be fetched.

backup.cloud.restore.unavailable.description: Message on the cloud restore page on a till that is not a connected main till.

backup.cloud.restore.requesting.description: Progress text right after a cloud restore was started.

backup.cloud.restore.approve_title.description: Heading while the till waits for the shop owner to approve a cloud restore.

backup.cloud.restore.approve_hint.description: Instruction while waiting for the owner's approval; the placeholder is the 8-character approval code.
placeholders: the approval code, for example K7QX29PM

backup.cloud.restore.qr_alt.description: Alternative text of the QR code the owner scans to approve a cloud restore.

backup.cloud.restore.waiting.description: Reassurance under the approval code while waiting.

backup.cloud.restore.downloading.description: Progress while a cloud backup downloads: part number and total number of parts.
placeholders: parts downloaded so far
total number of parts

backup.cloud.restore.checking.description: Progress while the downloaded backup is decrypted and checked.

backup.cloud.restore.ready.description: Shown when the cloud backup is staged and only a restart is left.

backup.cloud.restore.restart_manually.description: Shown instead of the Restart button on a device where the till cannot restart itself.

backup.cloud.restore.denied.description: Shown when the owner refused the restore on my.universaltill.com.

backup.cloud.restore.expired.description: Shown when the approval code expired before the owner approved.

backup.cloud.restore.cancelled.description: Shown after the manager cancelled a cloud restore.

backup.cloud.restore.cancel.description: Button that cancels a running cloud restore before anything is staged.

backup.cloud.restore.back.description: Link back to the cloud backup list after a restore stopped.

backup.cloud.restore.back_settings.description: Link from the cloud restore page back to the Backups settings.

backup.cloud.err.disk.description: Reason line: not enough free disk space for the off-site copy or the restore download.

backup.cloud.err.network.description: Reason line: network problem during the off-site copy.

backup.cloud.err.server.description: Reason line: the cloud answered with a server error.

backup.cloud.err.rate_limited.description: Reason line: the cloud asked the till to slow down.

backup.cloud.err.cloud_backup_not_in_pla.description: Reason line: the plan lacks the cloud backup feature.

backup.cloud.err.subscription_inactive.description: Reason line: the subscription is not active.

backup.cloud.err.not_main_till.description: Reason line: this till is not the shop's designated main till.

backup.cloud.err.too_large.description: Reason line: the backup is above the cloud size limit.

backup.cloud.err.not_enabled.description: Reason line: the cloud service has this feature switched off.

backup.cloud.err.corrupt.description: Error: the downloaded backup failed its integrity check.

backup.cloud.err.other_shop.description: Error: the backup is of a different shop.

backup.cloud.err.newer.description: Error: the backup needs a newer app version.

backup.cloud.err.too_old.description: Error: the backup is too old.

backup.cloud.err.consumed.description: Error: the approval was already used once.

backup.cloud.err.download.description: Error: a part of the backup could not be downloaded or failed its check.

backup.cloud.err.busy.description: Error: a second cloud restore was started.

backup.cloud.err.not_found.description: Error: the chosen backup is not in the cloud list.

backup.cloud.err.other.description: Generic error for cloud backup and restore.

backup.cloud.err.pair_again.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: the cloud rejects this till's device credential (401) on a store that has an owner; tells the manager to pair again.

backup.cloud.err.register_new.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: the cloud rejects this till's credential and the store has no owner yet; tells the manager to reconnect.

backup.cloud.err.till_replaced.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: the owner replaced this till as main till on my.universaltill.com, so it stops making cloud backups.

backup.cloud.err.till_moved.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: this till was moved to another shop.

backup.cloud.err.till_removed.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: this till was removed from the shop.

backup.cloud.err.shop_deleted.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card when the shop was deleted from its online account.

backup.cloud.err.cannot_prove.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card when the till cannot prove who it is; followed by a link to Till registration.

backup.cloud.err.reconnecting.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card while the till reconnects to its shop by itself; no action needed.

backup.cloud.err.service_unavailable.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card: the cloud does not offer its service to this shop (for example its country).

backup.cloud.err.upload_other.description: Reason line in the Cloud backups card for an upload failure with no more specific reason; the till retries by itself.

backup.cloud.err.open_registration.description: Link after a Cloud backups reason line; opens Settings → Till registration.

backup.cloud.state_needs_link.description: Status line in the Cloud backups card when the cloud holds the shop's backup key and this till does not (or holds a different one); the Link button is next to it.

backup.cloud.link.action.description: Button in the Cloud backups card that asks the shop owner to give this till the shop's backup key.

backup.cloud.key.chip_hint.description: Tooltip of the backup key choice chip.

backup.cloud.key.new_action.description: Button that makes a new backup key when the old one is lost.

backup.cloud.key.new_text.description: Warning shown next to Start a new backup key.

backup.cloud.key.enter_action.description: Label of the field where the saved backup key is typed to link this till.

backup.cloud.key.enter_label.description: Label of the saved backup key field.

backup.cloud.restore.needkey_hint.description: Instruction while a restore waits for the saved backup key.

backup.cloud.key.title.description: Heading of the backup key page.

backup.cloud.key.page_intro.description: Introduction on the backup key page.

refund.error.method_exhausted.description: Error shown on the refund screen when the sale's payments by the chosen method (e.g. card) have already been refunded so far that less is left than this return needs. Nothing is refunded or recorded; the cashier refunds the rest another way.

refund.error.leg_exhausted.description: Error on the refund screen when the payment the cashier picked has already been refunded so far that less is left than this return needs. Nothing is refunded or recorded.

refund.error.leg_unknown.description: Error on the refund screen when the submitted payment choice does not belong to this sale and method (e.g. a stale or edited form). Nothing is refunded.

refund.leg.legend.description: Refund screen: heading over the list of the sale's payments by the chosen method (shown only when there are two or more, e.g. a bill split over two cards); the cashier picks which one the refund goes back to. Also the prompt shown when Refund is tapped with no pick.

refund.leg.all.description: Refund screen, payment choice: option that spreads the refund over all of this method's payments, first payment first.

refund.leg.left.description: Refund screen, payment choice: how much of one payment can still be refunded.
placeholders: amount that can still be refunded to this payment

refund.error.outcome_unknown.description: Error shown on the refund screen when the card provider could not confirm whether a refund was sent to the customer. Tells the cashier it may already have been sent, that nothing is recorded yet, to tap Refund again on the same screen, and not to use another method or reload.

refund.error.refunded_not_recorded.description: Error on the refund screen when the card provider sent the money back to the customer but the till could not record the return. Tells the cashier not to refund again and that a manager must check Payments needing attention.

refund.error.already_sent.description: Error on the refund screen when the cashier sends the same refund again and the card provider already sent it back (it is still being recorded, or a manager has already handled it). Tells the cashier not to refund again and where to check.

refund.error.journal_unavailable.description: Error on the refund screen when the till could not write its safety record before asking the card provider, so the refund was not sent. Tells the cashier nothing was refunded and to try again or use another method.

refund.error.partial.description: Error shown on the refund screen when a refund over several card payments was sent back on some of them but failed on the rest. Tells the cashier nothing is recorded yet, to tap Refund again on the same screen to finish, and not to use another method or reload.

pos.toast.payment_declined_no_reader.description: Shown at the top of the cashier till's payment panel when a card payment plugin refused because this till has no card reader set up. Nothing was charged; tells the cashier what to do next.

pos.toast.payment_declined_reader_offlin.description: Shown at the top of the cashier till's payment panel when a card payment plugin refused because the card reader is not connected. Nothing was charged; tells the cashier what to do next.

pos.toast.payment_declined_reader_busy.description: Shown at the top of the cashier till's payment panel when a card payment plugin refused because the card reader is busy with another payment. Nothing was charged; tells the cashier what to do next.

pos.toast.payment_declined_auth_failed.description: Shown at the top of the cashier till's payment panel when a card payment plugin refused because the card payment service rejected this till's connection. Nothing was charged; tells the cashier what to do next.

pos.toast.payment_outcome_unknown.description: Error toast on the till when a card payment may have been charged but the reader could not confirm it: tells the cashier to tap Pay again to settle it and not to take another payment.

pos.toast.tender_abandoned_check_provide.description: Error toast on the till after the cashier cleared, parked or switched away from a sale with an unconfirmed card payment, when a payment could not be sent back automatically or its outcome is unknown: tells the cashier to check with the payment provider and refund there.

pos.toast.tender_abandoned_returned_unkn.description: Error toast on the till after the cashier cleared, parked or switched away from a sale whose card payment was still unconfirmed: payments already taken were sent back automatically, but one card payment's outcome is unknown and must be checked with the provider.

selforder.checkout.payment_journal_unava.description: Message on the self-order kiosk when the till could not record the card payment before asking the card reader, so the payment was never started: nothing was charged; sends the customer to the cashier.

pos.toast.payment_cancelled.description: Toast on the cashier till when the cashier cancelled a card tap and the payment service confirmed nothing was charged: the sale stays open.

pos.toast.payment_journal_unavailable.description: Toast on the cashier till when the till could not record a card payment before asking the card reader, so the payment was refused: nothing was charged and the basket is kept.

selforder.basket_locked_checkout.description: Toast in the self-order kiosk cart when a customer tries to change the basket while its checkout is still running (card payment at the kiosk, or placing a pay-at-counter / table order); the basket is left unchanged. Wording must fit both modes: no payment happens in counter mode.

selforder.checkout.outcome_unknown.description: Message on the self-order kiosk when the customer's card payment could not be confirmed: sends them to the cashier and tells them not to pay again.

tap.attention.start_refused.description: Title of the panel shown when a tap payment is refused before it starts because an earlier tap payment on the same provider is unresolved (after a restart, New sale or park). Nothing was charged; never worded as declined.

tap.attention.gone.description: JSON API error when a manager tries to settle a card payment that is already settled or does not exist.

tap.attention.in_progress.description: JSON API error when a manager tries to settle a card payment that is still in progress on a till's own sale screen.

tap.nothing_pending.description: Error shown when someone asks to check a tap-to-pay payment but this till has none waiting.

tap.pending.title.description: Heading of the screen shown on the till when a card tap may have been charged but the payment service has not confirmed it yet.

tap.pending.body.description: Body text under the heading of the unconfirmed tap payment screen: tells the cashier the customer may have been charged and not to take another payment before this is checked.

tap.pending.locked.description: Line on the unconfirmed tap payment screen saying the other payment methods are disabled until this payment is settled.

tap.pending.checking.description: Text on the Check again button while the till asks the payment service.

tap.pending.still.description: Message after Check again when the payment service still has not confirmed the payment.

tap.pending.reason.processing.description: Small reason line on the unconfirmed tap payment screen: the bank has not finished processing the payment.

tap.pending.reason.lookup_failed.description: Small reason line on the unconfirmed tap payment screen: the till could not reach the payment service to check.

tap.check_again.description: Button on the unconfirmed tap payment screen: asks the payment service again whether the customer was charged.

tap.cancel_payment.description: Button on the unconfirmed tap payment screen: asks the payment service first, then cancels the payment if nothing was charged.

tap.ask_manager.description: Button on the unconfirmed tap payment screen: opens the step where a manager settles the payment.

tap.ask_manager.hint.description: Text a cashier sees when they open the manager settle step: tells them to fetch a manager.

tap.not_paid.description: Result when the payment service confirms the tap payment was not charged: the sale is unlocked and can be paid again.

tap.paid_already.description: Result when the payment service confirms the tap payment had already gone through: the payment is approved.

tap.continue.description: Button that finishes the sale after a tap payment was found to be paid.

tap.start_failed.description: Message when a tap payment could not be started: nothing was charged. Must never say declined.

tap.amount_mismatch.description: Warning shown to a manager when the amount the payment service received differs from the sale amount.

tap.amount.expected.description: Label of the sale amount in the amount comparison shown to a manager.

tap.amount.received.description: Label of the amount actually charged in the amount comparison shown to a manager.

tap.amount.difference.description: Label of the difference between charged and sale amount in the comparison shown to a manager.

tap.result.try_again.description: Button to start a new tap payment attempt after a payment was not charged or could not start.

tap.result.other_method.description: Button to choose another payment method after a tap payment was not charged or could not start.

tap.result.card.description: Card brand and last four digits of a paid tap payment, for example 'visa ending 4242'.
placeholders: card brand as the provider reports it, lower case
last four digits of the card

tap.resolve.title.description: Heading of the manager's screen for settling an unconfirmed tap payment.

tap.resolve.sale_amount.description: Row label: the amount of the sale being settled.

tap.resolve.broker_status.description: Row label: what the payment service says about the payment.

tap.resolve.attempt_time.description: Row label: the time the tap payment attempt started.

tap.resolve.status.succeeded.description: What the payment service says when the payment went through.

tap.resolve.status.not_paid.description: What the payment service says when nothing was charged.

tap.resolve.status.unknown.description: Shown when the payment service could not be asked or has not decided yet.

tap.resolve.approve.description: Manager button: approve a tap payment the payment service confirms was charged.

tap.resolve.not_charged.description: Manager button: mark a tap payment as not charged and unlock the sale.

tap.resolve.override.description: Manager button: accept a payment whose charged amount differs from the sale amount and record it.

tap.resolve.confirm.description: Warning before a manager settles a tap payment without the payment service's answer: it is recorded with their name.

tap.resolve.confirm_btn.description: Button that confirms a manager override of a tap payment.

tap.resolve.audit_reason.description: Text stored in the audit log with a manager's settling of a tap payment. Not shown on screen.

tap.resolve.reason_label.description: Question above the reason choices when a manager settles a tap payment without the payment service's answer.

tap.resolve.reason.customer_left.description: Reason choice: the customer left without paying.

tap.resolve.reason.card_shown_charged.description: Reason choice: the customer's card shows as charged.

tap.resolve.reason.card_not_charged.description: Reason choice: the customer's card was not charged.

tap.resolve.reason.mismatch_refund_later.description: Reason choice: accept the amount difference and refund the rest outside the till.

tap.resolve.reason_required.description: Error when a manager tries to settle without choosing a reason.

tap.resolve.broker_says_paid.description: Error when a manager tries to mark a payment not charged while the payment service says it went through.

tap.resolve.nothing_to_approve.description: Error when a manager tries to approve a payment the payment service says was not charged.

tap.resolve.bad_choice.description: Error when a manager's settle choice is not one of the allowed ones.

tap.reader.pick.description: Heading of the panel where the cashier picks which card reader takes this payment, shown on the sale screen when the till has several readers.

tap.reader.busy_result.description: Title of the panel the cashier sees when a payment could not start because the paired phone reader answered that it was busy with another payment. Nothing was charged.

tap.reason.reader_busy.description: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen right now because another payment is running on it.

tap.reason.reader_unreachable.description: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen because the till cannot reach it (switched off, offline, out of range).

tap.reason.reader_needs_setup.description: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen because it is not set up yet; staff are told to ask a manager.

card_reader.pick.confirm.description: Button that starts the card payment once a reader is chosen. First placeholder is the amount to pay with its currency symbol, second is the reader's name.
placeholders: amount to pay, with currency symbol
name of the chosen card reader

card_reader.pick.back.description: Button in the reader picker that goes back to the list of payment methods without paying.

card_reader.pick.checking.description: Shown with a spinner while the till asks the card readers whether they are ready; takes at most a few seconds.

card_reader.pick.default_tag.description: Small tag on the reader that took the previous card payment on this till; it is chosen by default.

card_reader.pick.auto.description: Announced to screen readers when the only ready card reader is used without asking. The placeholder is the reader's name.
placeholders: name of the card reader

card_reader.pinned.description: Shown in the reader picker when a card payment was started and its result is unknown: it can only be retried on the same reader.

card_reader.offline.needs_internet.description: Note under a card reader in the reader list: a fixed fact about this kind of reader, not the current connection state. This reader cannot take a card payment while the till is offline. Never translate it as a promise.

card_reader.offline.external.description: Note under the shop's own terminal in the reader list: a fixed fact about this kind of reader, not the current connection state. It can take a card payment while the till is offline. Never translate it as a promise.

card_reader.none_ready.description: Shown in the reader picker when every card reader is busy, offline or needs setup.

card_reader.state.ready.description: State of a card reader that can take a payment now.

card_reader.state.busy.description: State of a card reader that is in use by another payment.

card_reader.state.offline.description: State of a card reader the till cannot reach.

card_reader.state.needs_setup.description: State of a card reader that is not set up yet.

card_reader.state.unchecked.description: State of a card reader whose readiness has not been checked yet.

card_reader.state.unknown.description: State of a card reader whose readiness could not be checked; it can still be tried.

card_reader.reason.unknown.description: One line under a card reader whose readiness could not be checked; it can still be chosen.

card_reader.kind.cloud.description: Kind label of a card terminal reached over the internet through its payment provider.

card_reader.kind.sdk.description: Kind label of a card reader driven by the payment provider's app on this phone or tablet, over Bluetooth or a cable.

card_reader.kind.external.description: Kind label of the shop's own card terminal that is not connected to the till; the cashier confirms the result.

card_reader.kind.phone.description: Kind label of a phone or tablet paired as a card reader.

card_reader.kind.tap_to_pay.description: Kind label of the entry that takes contactless payments on this phone or tablet itself.

card_reader.announce.changed.description: Announced to screen readers when a card reader's state changes while the picker is open. First placeholder is the reader's name, second its new state (Ready, Busy, Offline).
placeholders: name of the card reader
new state of the reader

card_reader.busy.description: Shown when the chosen card reader turned out to be in use; no payment was taken.

card_reader.invalid.description: Shown when the chosen card reader is no longer set up on this till; no payment was taken.
